items.title: Rehabilitation of Athletes With Hamstring Strain Injury: SONAFE-Brazil Clinical Practice Guideline.
items.summary: The National Society of Sports Physical Therapy (SONAFE-Brazil) has published a clinical practice guideline using the GRADE approach for rehabilitating athletes with hamstring strain injury, providing evidence-based guidance for physical therapists.
items.curatedReason: SONAFE-Brazil 发布的最新腘绳肌拉伤康复临床实践指南是本领域的里程碑，使用 GRADE 证据分级。它将直接指导你对运动员腘绳肌拉伤的康复干预策略，务必深入研读其推荐意见。
items.titleZh: 运动员腘绳肌拉伤的康复：SONAFE-巴西临床实践指南

items.curatedReasonEn: The latest clinical practice guideline for hamstring strain injury rehabilitation from SONAFE-Brazil, using GRADE, is a landmark in this field. It will directly inform your rehabilitation strategies for athletes with hamstring strain injuries, so be sure to study its recommendations thoroughly.

items.title: Is Reduced Spinal Range of Motion a Prognostic Factor for Pain Intensity, Disability, and Global Recovery in People With Specific or Nonspecific Spinal Pain? A Systematic Review.
items.summary: A systematic review of 37 studies found very low certainty evidence on whether reduced spinal range of motion is a prognostic factor for pain intensity, disability, and global recovery in people with specific or nonspecific spinal pain, with most studies reporting no clear association and high risk of bias.
items.curatedReason: 本系统综述（37 项研究）明确指出，脊柱活动度降低是否能预测脊柱疼痛患者的疼痛强度、残疾或整体恢复，证据确定性极低。别再把活动度限制当做核心预后指标，这可能分散你对其他更重要因素的注意力。
items.titleZh: 脊柱活动度降低是特异性或非特异性脊柱疼痛患者疼痛强度、残疾和整体恢复的预后因素吗？一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 37 项研究的系统综述发现，关于脊柱活动度降低是否能预测特异性或非特异性脊柱疼痛患者疼痛强度、残疾和整体恢复的证据确定性极低，多数研究未显示明确关联，且偏倚风险高。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review (37 studies) clearly states that the evidence for reduced spinal ROM predicting pain intensity, disability, or global recovery in spinal pain patients is of very low certainty. Stop treating ROM restriction as a core prognostic indicator, as this may distract you from more critical factors.
items.limitation: 纳入研究普遍存在高偏倚风险，且结果异质性高，导致证据确定性极低。
items.limitationEn: Included studies generally had a high risk of bias and high heterogeneity in results, leading to very low certainty of evidence.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Exercise-only interventions and exercise-based multidomain lifestyle interventions to promote cognitive function in older adults without dementia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 227 studies found that exercise-only interventions significantly improved executive functions, memory, and processing speed in older adults without dementia compared to control; exercise-plus interventions were significantly better than exercise-only for executive functions and processing speed.
items.curatedReason: 老年患者的执行功能、记忆和处理速度确实可以通过运动训练显著改善。在临床中，你应将运动作为改善老年人认知功能的常规干预措施，尤其是对于执行功能和处理速度，可考虑运动结合其他干预。
items.titleZh: 单纯运动干预和基于运动的多领域生活方式干预对无痴呆老年人认知功能的促进作用：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 227 项研究的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，与对照组相比，单纯运动干预显著改善了无痴呆老年人的执行功能、记忆和处理速度；多领域运动干预在执行功能和处理速度方面优于单纯运动干预。
items.curatedReasonEn: Exercise training consistently and significantly improves executive functions, memory, and processing speed in older adults. For your older adult patients, integrate exercise as a standard intervention to boost cognitive function; for executive functions and processing speed, consider combining exercise with other interventions.
items.limitation: 研究建议需要进一步探讨多领域运动干预的额外益处。
items.limitationEn: The study suggests further research is needed to determine the added benefit of multidomain exercise interventions.

items.title: Patients' experiences of participating in physiotherapeutic telerehabilitation for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction; a qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study (n=14) exploring patients' experiences with physiotherapeutic telerehabilitation for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction found it a valuable complement to physical visits, improving accessibility and continuity, while highlighting the need for advanced communication and reliable technology.
items.curatedReason: 远程康复能提高产后盆底功能障碍患者的可及性和依从性。研究提示，混合模式（远程与当面结合）最能满足患者需求，但在数字化沟通能力和技术支持上，你仍需下功夫。
items.titleZh: 产后盆底功能障碍患者参与物理治疗远程康复的体验：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究（n=14）探讨了产后盆底功能障碍患者参与物理治疗远程康复的体验，发现远程康复是实体就诊的有效补充，提高了可及性和依从性，但也强调了先进沟通技巧和可靠技术的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Telerehabilitation improves accessibility and adherence for postpartum pelvic floor dysfunction. Findings suggest a hybrid care model (remote + in-person) best meets patient needs, but you must focus on digital communication skills and robust tech support.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小，结果的外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Combining three-dimensional ankle exercises with short-foot training improves proprioception and dynamic balance in female karatekas with flatfoot: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=34) found that combining three-dimensional ankle exercises with short-foot training significantly improved navicular drop, ankle proprioception (decreased 3° vs 1.59°), and dynamic balance (increased Y-Balance reach by 17.49% vs 7.82%) in female karate athletes with flatfoot compared to short-foot exercise alone.
items.curatedReason: 针对扁平足的空足训练（SFE）增加三维踝关节练习（3DAE）后，在足部姿势、本体感觉和动态平衡上效果显著优于单独 SFE。这为跆拳道运动员等特定人群提供了更优的训练方案，你可以考虑将 3DAE 整合到你的方案中。
items.titleZh: 三维踝关节练习联合空足训练可改善扁平足女性跆拳道运动员的本体感觉和动态平衡：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=34）发现，在扁平足女性跆拳道运动员中，三维踝关节练习联合空足训练相比单独空足训练，显著改善了舟骨塌陷、踝关节本体感觉（下降 3° vs 1.59°）和动态平衡（Y 平衡测试得分提高 17.49% vs 7.82%）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adding 3D ankle exercises (3DAE) to short-foot exercises (SFE) for flatfoot significantly improved foot posture, proprioception, and dynamic balance compared to SFE alone. For athletes like female karatekas, consider integrating 3DAE into your training protocols.
items.limitation: SF-3DAE 组接受的监督训练量更大，无法完全排除训练量增加带来的影响，且未评估对运动表现或受伤风险的转化。
items.limitationEn: The SF-3DAE group received a greater volume of supervised exercise, which could not be fully separated from a general training-volume effect, and the study did not assess the translation of improvements to athletic performance or injury risk.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Beliefs and Practices of Pediatric Physiotherapists in Türkiye Regarding Early Mobility and Crawling.
items.summary: A survey of 109 pediatric physiotherapists in Türkiye found that 94.5% believed crawling was important for development, and 63% opposed its removal from CDC checklists, indicating a strong influence on their clinical practices.
items.curatedReason: 土耳其儿科物理治疗师普遍认为爬行对儿童发育很重要，这与 CDC 不再将其列为里程碑的观点存在分歧。这提示你在临床实践中需要平衡专业共识和官方指南，并持续关注新证据。
items.titleZh: 土耳其儿科物理治疗师关于早期运动和爬行的信念与实践
items.summaryZh: 一项对土耳其 109 名儿科物理治疗师的调查显示，94.5% 的受访者认为爬行对发育至关重要，63% 的人反对将其从 CDC 里程碑清单中移除，这强烈影响了他们的临床实践。
items.curatedReasonEn: Pediatric physical therapists in Türkiye widely believe crawling is crucial for child development, diverging from the CDC's decision to remove it from developmental milestones. This highlights the need to balance professional consensus with official guidelines in your practice, while staying current with new evidence.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面调查，仅反映土耳其的现状，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional survey reflects the current situation only in Türkiye, with limited generalizability of results.

items.title: Single Ultrasound-Guided Dextrose Prolotherapy Plus Therapeutic Exercise for Subacromial-Subdeltoid Bursitis: A Pilot Double-Blind Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: A pilot double-blind randomized controlled trial investigates the efficacy of single ultrasound-guided dextrose prolotherapy plus therapeutic exercise for subacromial-subdeltoid bursitis, a common cause of shoulder pain and disability.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 初步显示，单一超声引导下葡萄糖增生疗法联合治疗性运动可有效改善肩峰下-三角肌下滑囊炎。如果你的患者对常规治疗反应不佳，这可能是一个值得探索的新选择，但尚需大型研究来确证。
items.titleZh: 单一超声引导下葡萄糖增生疗法联合治疗性运动治疗肩峰下-三角肌下滑囊炎：一项初步双盲随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项初步双盲随机对照试验旨在探讨单一超声引导下葡萄糖增生疗法联合治疗性运动对肩峰下-三角肌下滑囊炎（一种常见的肩痛和致残原因）的疗效。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot RCT suggests that single ultrasound-guided dextrose prolotherapy combined with therapeutic exercise may be effective for subacromial-subdeltoid bursitis. If your patients are not responding to conventional treatments, this could be a new option to explore, but larger studies are needed for confirmation.
items.limitation: 本研究为小型预试验，样本量有限，结果的普适性需更多研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a small pilot study with a limited sample size, and the generalizability of its findings requires further validation with larger studies.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Establishing Consensus for Prescription of Prosthetic Components for Transtibial Bone-Anchored Limbs: An International Delphi Method Study
items.summary: An international Delphi method study aims to establish consensus and provide recommendations from experts on the prescription of prosthetic components for patients with transtibial bone-anchored limbs.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究通过国际德尔菲法，旨在为胫骨骨锚式假肢组件的处方建立共识。这对于你理解和应用骨锚式假肢的处方标准具有指导意义，有助于规范临床实践。
items.titleZh: 为胫骨骨锚式假肢组件的处方建立共识：一项国际德尔菲法研究
items.summaryZh: 一项国际德尔菲法研究旨在就胫骨骨锚式假肢患者的假肢组件处方达成专家共识并提供建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study aims to establish consensus for prescribing prosthetic components for transtibial bone-anchored limbs using an international Delphi method. This will guide your understanding and application of prescription standards for bone-anchored prostheses, helping standardize clinical practice.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Not Just Faster Horses: Telerehabilitation as a Necessary Evolution in Physical Therapy.
items.summary: This editorial argues that telerehabilitation is a necessary evolution in musculoskeletal physical therapy, extending the therapist's role through continuous monitoring and patient engagement, rather than merely replacing traditional care.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评强调远程康复应是肌骨物理治疗的“必要演进”，而非简单替代。要拥抱新模式，你必须培养新的数字技能，整合工具，同时维护医患关系。
items.titleZh: 不只是更快的马：远程康复作为物理治疗的必要演进
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评指出，远程康复是肌骨物理治疗的必要演进，它通过持续监测和患者参与来扩展治疗师的角色，而非仅仅替代传统治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial highlights telerehabilitation as a "necessary evolution" for musculoskeletal physical therapy, not just a replacement. To embrace new models, you must develop new digital skills, integrate tools, and maintain therapeutic relationships.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Repeated subgroup partitions preclude factor-specific inference for vagus nerve stimulation after stroke.
items.summary: A commentary suggests that repeated subgroup partitions in research on vagus nerve stimulation after stroke may hinder factor-specific inference.
items.curatedReason: 关于卒中后迷走神经刺激（VNS）的研究，该述评指出，重复的亚组划分可能会导致对因子特异性推断的混淆。在评估 VNS 这类复杂干预时，警惕过度解读或泛化特定亚组结果。
items.titleZh: 重复的亚组划分妨碍了卒中后迷走神经刺激因子特异性推断
items.summaryZh: 一项述评指出，卒中后迷走神经刺激（VNS）研究中重复的亚组划分，可能会妨碍对特定因子推断的有效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights that repeated subgroup partitions in vagus nerve stimulation (VNS) research post-stroke can preclude factor-specific inference. Be cautious of over-interpreting or over-generalizing findings from specific subgroups when evaluating complex interventions like VNS.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Mirror therapy versus functional electrical stimulation cycling in post-stroke lower limb rehabilitation: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=45) found that both mirror therapy (MD -2.60, 95% CI -5.83 to -0.63, p=0.004) and functional electrical stimulation-assisted cycling (MD -3.00, 95% CI -6.23 to -0.23, p=0.008) improved lower extremity motor function more than conventional rehabilitation in subacute stroke patients, with no significant difference between the two adjunct therapies.
items.curatedReason: 镜面疗法与功能性电刺激辅助循环训练在亚急性卒中下肢康复中均显示出优于常规治疗的效果，且两者之间无显著差异。这表明成本较低、更易获取的镜面疗法是可行的选择，在资源有限的诊所里，可以放心地将其作为下肢功能恢复的辅助干预手段。
items.titleZh: 卒中后下肢康复中的镜面疗法与功能性电刺激辅助循环训练：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=45）显示，亚急性卒中患者下肢康复中，镜面疗法（MD -2.60, 95% CI -5.83 to -0.63, p=0.004）和功能性电刺激辅助循环训练（MD -3.00, 95% CI -6.23 to -0.23, p=0.008）均比常规康复能带来更大的下肢运动功能改善，且两种辅助疗法之间无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Mirror therapy (MT) and functional electrical stimulation-assisted cycling (FES-C) both demonstrated superior outcomes to conventional therapy for subacute stroke lower limb rehabilitation, with no significant differences between them. This suggests that the more accessible and less costly MT is a viable option for lower limb functional recovery in resource-limited clinics, and you can confidently use it as an adjunct intervention.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（每组 15 人），随访期仅 6 周，可能限制了长期效果和更广泛人群的外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (15 per group) and a short 6-week follow-up, which may limit the generalizability of long-term effects and broader populations.

items.title: The enhanced rehabilitation programme for significant musculoskeletal injuries from the manchester arena bombing - A process evaluation study investigating patients' and physiotherapists' experiences.
items.summary: A process evaluation of the Enhanced Rehabilitation after Major Trauma Programme (ERP) in the UK, following the Manchester Arena bombing, found it was valued by patients and physiotherapists for its structured, multidisciplinary approach, but sustainability and integration into routine NHS care remain challenging.
items.curatedReason: 曼彻斯特竞技场爆炸案后的强化康复项目（ERP）效果积极，但大规模推广面临资源和系统障碍。这提示你在设计高强度康复项目时，需要同步考虑其在现实 NHS 系统中的可持续性和过渡衔接问题。
items.titleZh: 曼彻斯特竞技场爆炸案后严重肌肉骨骼损伤强化康复项目的过程评估：调查患者和物理治疗师的经验
items.summaryZh: 英国曼彻斯特竞技场爆炸案后实施的创伤强化康复项目（ERP）在患者和物理治疗师中获得积极评价，认可其结构化、多学科康复方法。但研究指出，该项目在 NHS 系统中的可持续性和与常规护理的衔接仍面临挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Enhanced Rehabilitation Programme (ERP) following the Manchester Arena bombing showed positive outcomes, but widespread adoption faces resource and systemic barriers. This suggests that when designing intensive rehabilitation programs, consider their sustainability and transition within real-world healthcare systems like the NHS.
items.limitation: 本研究采用定性方法，主要反映患者和物理治疗师的经验，而非量化项目疗效或成本效益。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study primarily reflects patient and physiotherapist experiences, not quantified treatment efficacy or cost-effectiveness.

items.title: Rehabilitation after stroke for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and Indigenous peoples globally: a scoping review and critical content analysis.
items.summary: A scoping review of 108 sources on stroke rehabilitation for Indigenous peoples globally reveals that care is heavily influenced by colonization, racism, and Western health perspectives, emphasizing the need for self-determined, culturally aligned rehabilitation models.
items.curatedReason: 这项综述揭示了全球原住民卒中康复中存在的系统性殖民影响和西方健康观主导的问题。这提示你在为原住民患者提供服务时，必须深入理解并整合其文化价值观和世界观，促进以患者为中心的自决康复模式。
items.titleZh: 全球原住民卒中康复：一项范围审查和批判性内容分析
items.summaryZh: 这项对全球原住民卒中康复的范围审查（纳入 108 篇文献）发现，康复服务深受殖民化、种族主义和西方健康观主导的影响。研究强调，未来的临床护理需要转变，以实现原住民自决的康复模式，并与他们的文化健康模式对齐。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review highlights systemic colonial impacts and the dominance of Western health perspectives in stroke rehabilitation for Indigenous peoples globally. This suggests that when treating Indigenous patients, you must deeply understand and integrate their cultural values and worldviews to promote patient-centered, self-determined rehabilitation models.
items.limitation: 本综述的广度可能限制了对特定原住民群体康复实践的深入分析。
items.limitationEn: The broad scope of this review may limit in-depth analysis of specific Indigenous rehabilitation practices.

items.title: Opioid use following spinal cord injury: a qualitative study of the perspectives of healthcare providers and people with lived experience.
items.summary: A qualitative study (n=23) in Australia found that opioid use post-spinal cord injury is often normalized in acute care, leading to overreliance that extends into rehabilitation and community settings due to limited follow-up and access to non-pharmacological pain support.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了澳大利亚脊髓损伤患者术后阿片类药物使用的复杂性，尤其是在院内易被常态化，且出院后缺乏持续支持。这提示你应更积极地在多学科团队中倡导全面的疼痛管理策略，减少阿片类药物依赖，并确保患者获得非药物疼痛支持。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤后阿片类药物使用：一项关于医疗服务提供者和有生活经验者的视角的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项在澳大利亚进行的定性研究（n=23）发现，脊髓损伤后阿片类药物使用在急性期护理中被常态化，导致患者在康复和社区环境中过度依赖，这主要归因于后续随访不足以及非药物疼痛支持的可及性有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights the complexity of opioid use post-spinal cord injury in Australia, noting its normalization in acute care and lack of sustained support post-discharge. This suggests you should more actively advocate for comprehensive pain management strategies within multidisciplinary teams, reduce opioid reliance, and ensure patients access non-pharmacological pain support.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性探索，样本量较小（23 名参与者），结果主要反映澳大利亚特定医疗背景下的观点，不宜直接外推到其他国家或量化阿片类药物使用的具体风险。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative exploratory study has a small sample size (23 participants) and its findings primarily reflect perspectives within a specific Australian healthcare context, limiting direct generalizability or quantification of opioid use risks.

items.title: Return to sports after lumbar disc herniation surgery: a survey of German surgeons and postoperative patient experiences.
items.summary: A survey of German surgeons (n=183) showed variability in recommendations for return to sports after lumbar disc herniation surgery, with most suggesting regular activity from around 8 weeks. A separate patient survey (n=106) reported actual return to sports at 12.1 ± 11.7 weeks, highlighting a discrepancy between recommendations and patient behavior.
items.curatedReason: 这项德国研究显示，腰椎间盘突出手术后重返运动的时间存在显著差异，外科医生建议的时间与患者实际重返时间不一致。这提示你在制定患者重返运动计划时，不应只依赖单一医生的建议，而应更精细地评估患者个体情况和功能进展，同时认识到现有指南的证据局限性。
items.titleZh: 腰椎间盘突出手术后重返运动：一项德国外科医生调查与患者术后经验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对德国外科医生（n=183）的调查显示，腰椎间盘突出手术后重返运动的建议存在差异，多数建议在术后约 8 周恢复常规运动。另一项针对患者（n=106）的调查则报告实际重返运动时间为 12.1 ± 11.7 周，凸显了建议与患者行为之间的差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This German study reveals significant variability in return-to-sport timing after lumbar disc herniation surgery, with surgeon recommendations not aligning with actual patient return. This suggests that when creating return-to-sport plans, you should not rely solely on a single physician's advice but rather conduct a more nuanced assessment of individual patient conditions and functional progress, while acknowledging the limited evidence in current guidelines.
items.limitation: 本研究结合了外科医生在线问卷和单中心患者调查，两者设计和背景存在差异，数据不直接可比，且患者样本量相对较小。
items.limitationEn: This study combined an online surgeon survey and a single-center patient survey, which have differing designs and contexts, making their data not directly comparable, and the patient sample size is relatively small.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Item-level analysis and network analysis of the functional independence measure cognitive items at discharge after acute stroke.
items.summary: This study characterized item-level profiles and inter-item relationships of the five FIM cognitive items at discharge after acute stroke in 974 patients. It found two major conditional associations: comprehension-expression (r = 0.71) and memory-problem solving (r = 0.55).
items.curatedReason: 针对卒中急性期出院患者，FIM 认知子量表的项目间网络分析提示：理解-表达（r=0.71）和记忆-问题解决（r=0.55）存在强关联。这意味着在评估和干预时，应将这些高度关联的认知功能作为一个整体来考虑，而非孤立地处理。
items.titleZh: 急性卒中出院后功能独立性评定认知项目的项目层面分析和网络分析。
items.summaryZh: 本研究对 974 名急性卒中患者出院时功能独立性评定 (FIM) 认知项目的项目层面特征和项目间关系进行了网络分析。结果显示，理解-表达 (r = 0.71) 和记忆-问题解决 (r = 0.55) 是两个主要的条件关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: For acute stroke patients at discharge, network analysis of FIM cognitive subscale items suggests strong associations between comprehension-expression (r=0.71) and memory-problem solving (r=0.55). This implies these highly correlated cognitive functions should be considered holistically during assessment and intervention, rather than in isolation.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性分析，且结果需要未来在外部结果中进行复制和纵向验证。
items.limitationEn: This study is a retrospective analysis, and its findings warrant replication and longitudinal validation against external outcomes.

items.title: Hemodynamic Responses to Cold Water Ingestion During Head-Up Tilt
items.summary: In a randomized crossover study with 19 healthy young adults, drinking 200 mL of cold water during head-up tilt attenuated the fall in SBP by 5.95 mmHg (95% CI 1.99 to 9.91) in the first 4 minutes after drinking, compared to no water or body-temperature water.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对健康年轻人的 RCT 表明，在体位性应激时饮用 200 mL 冷水能在 4 分钟内将收缩压下降幅度减少约 6 mmHg。虽然样本量很小，这提示我们可以尝试建议体位性低血压患者在站立时小口饮用冷水，以期快速缓解症状，但需提醒这并非长久之计。
items.titleZh: 仰卧倾斜时冷水摄入的血流动力学反应。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 19 名健康年轻人进行的随机交叉研究显示，在仰卧倾斜时饮用 200 毫升冷水，可在饮用后最初 4 分钟内将收缩压下降幅度减少 5.95 mmHg（95% CI 1.99 至 9.91），优于不饮水或饮用常温水。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT in healthy young adults suggests that drinking 200 mL of cold water during orthostatic stress can reduce the fall in SBP by about 6 mmHg within 4 minutes. While the sample size is small, it hints that we might cautiously suggest patients with orthostatic hypotension sip cold water when standing for quick symptom relief, but emphasize this is not a long-term solution.
items.limitation: 这是一项在健康年轻人中进行的初步研究，结果是预印本，且未评估对病理状态下体位性低血压患者的临床意义。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary preprint study conducted in healthy young adults, and its clinical significance for patients with pathological orthostatic hypotension has not been assessed.

items.title: Stakeholder-informed prioritisation of HealthTech innovation across chronic respiratory disease: the HERON study
items.summary: The HERON study identified 73 candidate HealthTech solution areas across 16 priority domains for chronic respiratory disease (CRD) through stakeholder engagement (N=314 patients, carers, HCPs), with 52/73 (71.2%) having existing technological capability.
items.curatedReason: 这项利益相关者共识研究指出了慢性呼吸系统疾病 HealthTech 解决方案的 16 个优先领域，其中 71.2% 已有技术基础。作为临床医生，这提醒我们关注这些新兴技术，思考如何将其整合到日常实践中，以更好地支持患者的自我管理和疾病治疗，而不是等待现有方案迭代。
items.titleZh: 慢性呼吸系统疾病 HealthTech 创新的利益相关者优先排序：HERON 研究。
items.summaryZh: HERON 研究通过利益相关者（314 名患者、护理人员、医疗专业人员）参与，确定了慢性呼吸系统疾病 (CRD) 的 73 个 HealthTech 候选解决方案领域，涵盖 16 个优先领域，其中 52/73 (71.2%) 已具备现有技术能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This stakeholder consensus study highlights 16 priority domains for HealthTech solutions in chronic respiratory disease, with 71.2% having existing technological capability. As clinicians, this prompts us to pay attention to these emerging technologies and consider how to integrate them into daily practice to better support patient self-management and disease treatment, rather than waiting for current solutions to iterate.
items.limitation: 本研究主要依赖利益相关者的主观意见，优先级的确定可能受限于参与者的背景和当前认知。
items.limitationEn: This study primarily relies on subjective stakeholder opinions, and prioritization may be limited by participants' backgrounds and current understanding.

items.title: Impact of Daily Physical Fatigue on Inter-Limb Load Asymmetry and Joint Loading Rates During Daily Living Tasks in Unilateral Knee Osteoarthritis
items.summary: A cross-sectional study (n=118) on unilateral knee OA patients found that physical fatigue significantly increased inter-limb load asymmetry during daily tasks (mean difference 8.7%), with stair negotiation showing the largest increase, potentially accelerating joint degeneration.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现，身体疲劳会加剧单侧膝骨关节炎患者在日常活动中的肢体负荷不对称，尤其是爬楼梯。这提示你在评估膝 OA 患者时应考虑疲劳因素对步态生物力学的影响，并可能需要将疲劳管理和负荷重新分配作为干预重点。
items.titleZh: 单侧膝骨关节炎患者日常身体疲劳对肢体间负荷不对称和关节负荷率的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 118 名单侧膝骨关节炎患者的横断面研究发现，身体疲劳会显著加剧日常活动中的肢体间负荷不对称（平均差异 8.7%），尤其是在爬楼梯时，这可能加速关节退化。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that physical fatigue exacerbates inter-limb load asymmetry in unilateral knee OA patients during daily tasks, especially stair negotiation. This suggests you should consider the impact of fatigue on gait biomechanics when assessing knee OA patients and potentially prioritize fatigue management and load redistribution in interventions.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立疲劳与关节退化之间的因果关系，且生物力学测量是在实验室环境下进行的，可能与实际日常活动存在差异。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which cannot establish causality between fatigue and joint degeneration. Biomechanical measurements were also performed in a laboratory setting, which may differ from real-world daily activities.

items.title: Smartphone Applications for Assisting Outdoor and Indoor Navigation for Persons with Blindness or Low Vision
items.summary: This Information/Education Page reviews key smartphone navigation applications for people with blindness or low vision (pBLV) to help clinicians identify beneficial tools for supporting patients' independent living.
items.curatedReason: 这份页面并非研究，但它提供了一个便利的综述，帮你快速了解目前市面上针对视障人士（pBLV）的主流导航App。这能协助你为患者推荐合适的工具，增强其独立生活能力。
items.titleZh: 视障人士辅助室外和室内导航的智能手机应用
items.summaryZh: 这份信息/教育页面探讨了面向视障人士的智能手机导航应用，旨在帮助临床医生更好地识别和推荐有助于患者独立生活的工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: This page isn't a study, but it offers a convenient overview of major navigation apps for people with blindness or low vision (pBLV). Use it to recommend suitable tools for your patients, empowering their independent living.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: The Effects of a Digital Exercise Therapy Application for Patients with Shoulder and Knee Pain During the COVID-19 Pandemic
items.summary: A retrospective analysis of a digital exercise therapy application (DETA) for non-operative knee and shoulder pain found clinically meaningful improvements in pain interference (3.9 points decrease) and physical function (3.5 points increase) at 8 weeks, with greater benefits for knee pain, higher education, acute symptoms, and moderate-to-high exercise exertion.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，数字运动疗法应用（DETA）对膝关节和肩关节疼痛患者的疼痛干扰和功能有临床意义的改善。对于症状较急、文化程度较高且在运动中能报告中高强度劳累的患者，DETA 可能是一个有效的辅助工具。
items.titleZh: COVID-19 疫情期间数字运动疗法应用对肩膝疼痛患者的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性分析发现，针对非手术膝关节和肩关节疼痛患者的数字运动疗法应用（DETA）在 8 周时可带来临床意义上的疼痛干扰（降低 3.9 分）和身体功能（提高 3.5 分）改善，其中膝关节疼痛患者、受教育程度较高、症状较急以及运动劳累程度中高的患者受益更大。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that a digital exercise therapy application (DETA) provides clinically meaningful improvements in pain interference and function for patients with knee and shoulder pain. DETA may be an effective adjunct for patients with more acute symptoms, higher education levels, and those who report moderate-to-high exertion during exercise.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性分析，可能存在选择偏倚，且缺乏对照组，无法排除安慰剂效应或其他混杂因素的影响。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective analysis, which may be subject to selection bias and lacks a control group, thus unable to rule out placebo effects or other confounding factors.

items.title: Blood pressure following resistance exercise in individuals in the chronic phase of stroke recovery
items.summary: A study (n=11 chronic stroke, n=19 controls) compared post-exercise blood pressure (BP) responses after a single bout of leg-press exercise and found no significant differences in systolic or diastolic BP changes between individuals with and without chronic stroke, suggesting similar acute BP responses.
items.curatedReason: 这项小样本研究提示，慢性卒中患者在抗阻训练后，血压反应与健康对照组相似，支持抗阻训练的安全性。但在制定卒中患者的抗阻训练计划时，仍需考虑个体差异和更全面心血管风险评估。
items.titleZh: 卒中恢复慢性期患者抗阻运动后的血压反应
items.summaryZh: 一项研究（11 名慢性卒中患者，19 名对照组）比较了单次腿举抗阻运动后血压反应，发现慢性卒中患者与无卒中个体在收缩压和舒张压变化上无显著差异，提示急性血压反应相似。
items.curatedReasonEn: This small-sample study suggests that blood pressure responses after resistance exercise are similar in chronic stroke patients and healthy controls, supporting the safety of resistance training. However, when developing resistance training plans for stroke patients, individual differences and a more comprehensive cardiovascular risk assessment should still be considered.
items.limitation: 研究样本量非常小（11 例卒中患者），且对照组与卒中组年龄不匹配，这些都限制了结果的普遍性和确定性。
items.limitationEn: The study has a very small sample size (11 stroke patients) and the control group was not age-matched with the stroke group, limiting the generalizability and certainty of the findings.

items.title: Barriers and facilitators of decision-making in home-based rehabilitation exercise among older adults following total knee arthroplasty: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 21 older adults post-total knee arthroplasty identified intuitive avoidance responses and external support constraints as barriers to home-based exercise, while rational adherence and negotiation strategies facilitated engagement, with implications for pain management and individualized goal setting.
items.curatedReason: 对于全膝关节置换术（TKA）术后的居家康复，你可能会发现患者的依从性挑战。这项对21位老年人的定性研究提示，除了疼痛，患者对运动的“直觉规避”和外部支持不足是主要障碍；而“理性坚持”和协商策略能促进他们参与。在制定居家方案时，请考虑如何识别并应对这些内在和外在因素。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换术后老年患者居家康复锻炼决策中的障碍与促进因素：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对21名全膝关节置换术后老年患者的定性研究发现，直觉回避反应和外部支持限制是居家康复锻炼的障碍，而理性坚持和协商策略能促进参与。研究结果提示可优化疼痛管理和个体化目标设定。
items.curatedReasonEn: You'll likely encounter adherence challenges with home-based rehabilitation after total knee arthroplasty (TKA). This qualitative study of 21 older adults suggests that beyond pain, patients' 'intuitive avoidance' of exercise and lack of external support are key barriers, while 'rational adherence' and negotiation strategies facilitate engagement. When prescribing home programs, consider how to identify and address these intrinsic and extrinsic factors.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且仅限于中国三家三级医院的患者，可能影响结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study's relatively small sample size, limited to patients from three tertiary hospitals in China, may affect the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Shear wave elastography for assessing lower extremity muscle stiffness after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction: A systematic review.
items.summary: A systematic review of six studies (173 ACLR participants, 79 controls) found shear wave elastography (SWE) detects muscle-specific mechanical deficits after ACLR, with reduced passive vastus medialis shear modulus (g -1.10 to -1.21) and semitendinosus stiffness (g -1.29 to -1.64) after hamstring harvest.
items.curatedReason: SWE 能捕捉 ACLR 术后股内侧肌和半腱肌在被动状态下的剪切模量和僵硬度下降（g值在-1.10至-1.64之间），这提示即使患者力量达标，其着地僵硬和再损伤风险可能仍高于预期。考虑引入 SWE 作为传统力量测试的补充，以更客观地评估肌肉力学特性。
items.titleZh: 剪切波弹性成像评估前交叉韧带重建术后下肢肌肉僵硬度：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 6 项研究（173 名 ACLR 参与者，79 名对照）的系统综述发现，剪切波弹性成像（SWE）能够检测 ACLR 术后肌肉特异性机械缺陷，表现为股内侧肌被动剪切模量（g -1.10 至 -1.21）和腘绳肌腱取后半腱肌僵硬度（g -1.29 至 -1.64）降低。
items.curatedReasonEn: SWE reveals reduced passive shear modulus and stiffness in the vastus medialis and semitendinosus after ACLR (g values between -1.10 and -1.64), suggesting that even patients meeting strength benchmarks may still have higher than expected landing stiffness and re-injury risk. Consider integrating SWE to objectively assess muscle mechanics, complementing traditional strength testing.
items.limitation: 现有研究的质量从差到好不等，且尚未有标准化协议来采样临床相关区域或长期随访至重返赛场。
items.limitationEn: Existing studies range from poor to good quality, and standardized protocols are still needed for sampling clinically relevant regions or following patients to return to sport.

items.title: Short term effectiveness of dry needling and instrument assisted soft tissue mobilization in knee osteoarthritis patients - a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (N=34) found that dry needling was superior to instrument-assisted soft tissue mobilization (IASTM) and conventional treatment for significant pain reduction, function, and knee ROM improvement in knee osteoarthritis patients at 4 and 6 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提示，对于膝骨关节炎患者，干针疗法在短期内（4-6 周）改善疼痛、功能和关节活动度方面可能优于筋膜枪辅助软组织松动术（IASTM）和传统治疗。这为干针作为 KOA 康复的有效手段提供了额外的支持。
items.titleZh: 干针疗法与筋膜枪辅助软组织松动术对膝骨关节炎患者的短期疗效：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（N=34）发现，对于膝骨关节炎患者，干针疗法在第 4 周和第 6 周在显著减轻疼痛、改善功能和膝关节活动度方面优于筋膜枪辅助软组织松动术（IASTM）和常规治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that for knee osteoarthritis patients, dry needling may be superior to instrument-assisted soft tissue mobilization (IASTM) and conventional treatment in improving pain, function, and range of motion over the short term (4-6 weeks). This provides additional support for dry needling as an effective modality in KOA rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（34 名参与者），随访时间较短（6 周），可能限制结果的长期外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (34 participants) and a short follow-up period (6 weeks), which may limit the long-term generalizability of the results.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Physical Performance and Central Nervous System–Active Analgesics Independently Predict 8-Year Fall Risk in Adults with or at Risk for Knee Osteoarthritis
items.summary: Physical performance and central nervous system (CNS)–active analgesics independently predict 8-year fall risk in adults with or at risk for knee osteoarthritis.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究强调了身体机能表现和中枢神经系统（CNS）活性镇痛药独立预测膝骨关节炎患者 8 年跌倒风险的重要性。在制定跌倒预防策略时，需要同时关注患者的运动能力和用药情况，而不仅仅是疼痛管理。
items.titleZh: 身体机能表现和中枢神经系统活性镇痛药独立预测膝骨关节炎成人 8 年跌倒风险
items.summaryZh: 研究显示，身体机能表现和中枢神经系统（CNS）活性镇痛药能够独立预测膝骨关节炎患者或高危人群在 8 年内的跌倒风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights the independent predictive importance of physical performance and CNS-active analgesics for 8-year fall risk in adults with or at risk for knee osteoarthritis. When developing fall prevention strategies, address both patients' physical capabilities and medication use, beyond just pain management.
items.limitation: 文章摘要中未明确研究设计（队列、观察等）及样本量，无法评估其外推性。
items.limitationEn: The article abstract does not clearly state the study design (cohort, observational, etc.) or sample size, making it difficult to assess generalizability.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Calf Injuries: An Anatomy-Based Approach to Diagnosis, Management and Return to Sport.
items.summary: A review of calf muscle injuries highlights the heterogeneity of lesions and emphasizes an anatomy-based approach to diagnosis and management, moving beyond muscle-based classifications. It supports criteria-based, progressive loading rehabilitation and multifactorial return-to-sport decisions, noting limited evidence linking specific anatomical patterns to prognosis.
items.curatedReason: 这份综述强调了小腿肌肉损伤的异质性，并提出基于解剖学特征而非单纯肌肉的诊断方法。它强化了以功能为导向的渐进性负重康复原则，并提示返赛决策应多因素综合考量，而非依赖单一影像或时限。
items.titleZh: 小腿损伤：基于解剖学的方法诊断、管理和重返运动
items.summaryZh: 一篇关于小腿肌肉损伤的综述强调了病变的异质性，并强调了基于解剖学而非单纯肌肉的诊断和管理方法。该综述支持基于标准的渐进性负重康复和多因素的重返运动决策，并指出将特定解剖模式与预后关联的证据有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review highlights the heterogeneity of calf muscle injuries and suggests an anatomy-based diagnostic approach over a simple muscle-based one. It reinforces the principles of function-led, progressive loading rehabilitation and advises multifactorial return-to-sport decisions rather than relying on isolated imaging or fixed timelines.

items.title: Prediction model for timing of independent walking on varied surface conditions in patients with early subacute stroke: A multicenter prospective study.
items.summary: A multicenter prospective observational study developed and internally validated a Cox proportional hazards model to predict the timing of independent walking on varied surfaces (FAC 5) in 168 early subacute stroke patients. The model, using routine assessments, showed favorable internal performance (AUC 0.86-0.92).
items.curatedReason: 这个多中心前瞻性研究提供了一个模型，可以预测早期亚急性卒中患者在多种表面上独立行走的时间。该模型在内部验证中表现良好（AUC 0.86-0.92），对临床规划和目标设定有参考价值。
items.titleZh: 早期亚急性卒中患者在多种表面上独立行走时间的预测模型：一项多中心前瞻性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心前瞻性观察研究开发并内部验证了一个 Cox 比例风险模型，用于预测 168 名早期亚急性卒中患者在多种表面（FAC 5）上独立行走的时间。该模型基于常规评估，内部验证表现良好（AUC 0.86-0.92）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multicenter prospective study presents a model to predict the timing of independent walking on varied surfaces for early subacute stroke patients. The model showed favorable internal validation performance (AUC 0.86-0.92), offering a useful reference for clinical planning and goal setting.
items.limitation: 该模型还需要外部验证才能应用于临床实践。
items.limitationEn: The model requires external validation before clinical implementation.

items.title: APTA Launches Campaign Tools for National Physical Therapy Month
items.summary: The American Physical Therapy Association (APTA) launched its "PT for Future Me" campaign tools for National Physical Therapy Month, aiming to raise consumer awareness about physical therapy's role in lifelong health and wellness.
items.curatedReason: 美国物理治疗协会（APTA）启动了“我的未来物理治疗”宣传活动，旨在提升公众对物理治疗在全生命周期健康管理中作用的认知。这个活动是向你的患者和社区宣传物理治疗价值的好机会，利用APTA提供的资源扩大影响力。
items.titleZh: APTA 为全国物理治疗月启动宣传工具
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会（APTA）为全国物理治疗月启动了“我的未来物理治疗”宣传工具，旨在提高消费者对物理治疗在全生命周期健康和福祉中作用的认知。
items.curatedReasonEn: The APTA has launched its "PT For Future Me" campaign to raise public awareness of physical therapy's role in lifelong health management. This campaign is a valuable opportunity for you to promote the value of physical therapy to your patients and community, leveraging the resources provided by APTA to amplify your message.

items.title: A Return to Performance Continuum for Football (Soccer) Players After ACL Reconstruction: Bridging Rehabilitation, Return to Play and Sustained Performance.
items.summary: This paper outlines a staged return-to-performance continuum for football players after ACL reconstruction, comprising structured on-field rehabilitation, return to team training, return to competitive match play, and sustained performance, underpinned by four interdependent pillars: movement quality, technical/tactical re-training, physical reconditioning, and neuromuscular performance restoration.
items.curatedReason: ACL 重建术后，足球运动员重返赛场并维持表现是个难题。这份综述明确了阶段性康复的四个关键支柱：运动质量、技术/战术再训练、身体再调理和神经肌肉功能恢复，为你的训练计划提供了扎实的框架。
items.titleZh: 足球运动员 ACL 重建术后重返赛场表现连续体：衔接康复、重返比赛与持续表现
items.summaryZh: 本文概述了足球运动员 ACL 重建术后重返赛场表现的阶段性连续体，包括结构化场上康复、重返团队训练、重返竞技比赛和维持表现，并由运动质量、技术战术再训练、身体再调理和神经肌肉表现恢复四大支柱支撑。
items.curatedReasonEn: After ACL reconstruction, getting football players back to peak performance and sustaining it is tough. This review clarifies the four critical pillars for staged rehabilitation—movement quality, technical/tactical re-training, physical reconditioning, and neuromuscular performance restoration—providing a solid framework for your training protocols.
items.limitation: 这是一篇共识性综述，其推荐基于现有文献的综合解读和专家意见，而非单个原始研究数据。
items.limitationEn: This is a consensus review, and its recommendations are based on a synthesis of existing literature and expert opinion rather than primary research data.

items.title: Finding the rhythm
items.summary: This editorial introduces the annual Norwegian Sports and Exercise Medicine Society issue of BJSM, focusing on the theme of 'timing' across daily, seasonal, and lifespan scales, highlighting papers on sleep health in sport and the distinct associations of stepping intensity and daily volume with mortality.
items.curatedReason: 这份社论为你梳理了本期 BJSM 中关于运动表现、睡眠健康和身体活动强度与死亡率关联的最新研究，提醒你在康复和运动处方中考虑时间生物学和活动细节，而不仅仅是步数。
items.titleZh: 寻找节奏：挪威运动与运动医学学会特刊导读
items.summaryZh: 这份社论介绍了《英国运动医学杂志》挪威运动与运动医学学会年度特刊，以“时机”为核心主题，涵盖日常、季节和寿命尺度，重点介绍了运动睡眠健康和步频与步数对死亡率的不同关联研究。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial provides an overview of the latest BJSM research on sports performance, sleep health, and the association between physical activity intensity and mortality. It reminds you to consider chronobiology and activity specifics, beyond just step counts, in your rehabilitation and exercise prescriptions.

items.title: Effects of TENS, NMES, and Combination Therapy on Hemiplegic Shoulder Pain and Function After Stroke.
items.summary: A 3-week RCT (N=60) found that combined TENS and NMES significantly reduced hemiplegic shoulder pain (VAS) and SPADI scores compared to TENS alone in acute and subacute stroke patients. All groups improved across multiple outcomes, but the combined therapy did not significantly improve upper extremity motor function, spasticity, or ADLs beyond individual therapies.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后偏瘫肩痛（HSP）的早期康复中，经皮神经电刺激（TENS）联合神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）在减轻疼痛和肩部相关功能受限方面优于单独使用 TENS 或 NMES，提示你在临床实践中可以考虑联合电刺激以优化患者的疼痛管理和肩部功能恢复。
items.titleZh: TENS、NMES 及联合疗法对卒中后偏瘫肩痛和功能的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 3 周的随机对照试验（N=60）发现，在急性和亚急性卒中患者中，经皮神经电刺激（TENS）和神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）的联合治疗在减轻偏瘫肩痛（VAS）和肩痛与残疾指数（SPADI）评分方面显著优于单独使用 TENS。所有组在多项结果指标上均有改善，但联合疗法在改善上肢运动功能、痉挛或日常生活活动能力方面并未显著超越单独疗法。
items.curatedReasonEn: In early rehabilitation for hemiplegic shoulder pain (HSP) after stroke, combined transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation (TENS) and neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) is superior to TENS or NMES alone in reducing pain and shoulder-related functional limitations. This suggests you might consider combined electrical stimulation in clinical practice to optimize patient pain management and shoulder function recovery.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量较小（N=60），且随访期短（3 周），未能评估联合电刺激的长期效果和对上肢运动功能、痉挛或日常生活活动能力的影响。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (N=60) and short follow-up (3 weeks), failing to assess the long-term effects of combined electrical stimulation or its impact on upper extremity motor function, spasticity, or activities of daily living.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Cross-cultural adaptation and validation of the Short Form Stroke Impact Scale (SF-SIS) into Arabic among stroke survivors in Saudi Arabia.
items.summary: This cross-sectional study (N=130) validated the Arabic version of the Short Form Stroke Impact Scale (SF-SIS-Ar) for stroke survivors in Saudi Arabia, demonstrating excellent internal consistency (Cronbach's α = 0.87-0.97) and test-retest reliability (ICC = 0.78-0.94), with strong to moderate correlations with other established measures.
items.curatedReason: 《卒中影响量表短表》阿拉伯语版（SF-SIS-Ar）的文化适应和验证成功，为中东地区的卒中康复专业人员提供了可靠且有效的患者自评工具，有助于更精准地评估患者康复质量和功能影响。
items.titleZh: 《卒中影响量表短表》（SF-SIS）阿拉伯语版在沙特阿拉伯卒中幸存者中的跨文化适应与验证
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究（N=130）验证了《卒中影响量表短表》（SF-SIS）的阿拉伯语版本（SF-SIS-Ar）在沙特阿拉伯卒中幸存者中的应用，结果显示其具有出色的内部一致性（Cronbach's α = 0.87-0.97）和重测信度（ICC = 0.78-0.94），并与其他成熟量表呈现强至中度相关性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The successful cultural adaptation and validation of the Arabic Short Form Stroke Impact Scale (SF-SIS-Ar) provide a reliable and valid patient-reported outcome measure for stroke rehabilitation professionals in the Middle East, enabling more precise assessment of patient recovery quality and functional impact.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法评估 SF-SIS-Ar 在追踪卒中康复进程中的反应性或纵向变化。
items.limitationEn: This study used a cross-sectional design, which limits the assessment of SF-SIS-Ar's responsiveness or longitudinal changes in tracking stroke rehabilitation progress.

items.title: Vestibular rehabilitation therapy in Turkey: insights into physical therapists' clinical practice.
items.summary: A survey of 178 physical therapists in Turkey revealed significant gaps in vestibular rehabilitation therapy (VRT) knowledge and practice: 88.8% had no VRT experience, and over 60% were unfamiliar with various maneuvers (e.g., Epley, Semont) and advanced techniques (e.g., optokinetic stimulation, virtual reality).
items.curatedReason: 土耳其物理治疗师在前庭康复治疗（VRT）方面的知识和实践存在显著空白，特别是在手法操作和先进技术应用方面，提示当地继续教育和本科课程急需强化 VRT 培训，以提升循证实践水平和患者可及性。
items.titleZh: 土耳其的前庭康复治疗：物理治疗师临床实践洞察
items.summaryZh: 一项针对土耳其 178 名物理治疗师的调查显示，他们在前庭康复治疗（VRT）的知识和实践方面存在显著空白：88.8% 的受访者没有 VRT 经验，超过 60% 的人对各种手法（如 Epley、Semont）和先进技术（如视动刺激、虚拟现实）不熟悉。
items.curatedReasonEn: Turkish physical therapists exhibit significant gaps in vestibular rehabilitation therapy (VRT) knowledge and practice, particularly in manual maneuvers and advanced techniques. This highlights an urgent need to strengthen VRT training in local continuing education and undergraduate curricula to enhance evidence-based practice and patient access.
items.limitation: 本研究采用在线问卷调查，可能存在选择偏倚，且无法计算传统应答率，结果的普适性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: This study used an online survey, which may introduce selection bias and prevent calculation of a conventional response rate, potentially limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Movement matters: the path to professional impact.
items.summary: This article highlights the extensive contributions of Dr. Christopher M. Powers, the 57th McMillan Lecturer, to physical therapy through his leadership in human movement science, research on lower-extremity biomechanics, and consistent advocacy for the profession.
items.curatedReason: 这篇述评是对 Christopher M. Powers 教授在第 57 届 McMillan 讲座上职业贡献的概括，不含新的研究发现或临床实践指导。
items.titleZh: 运动至关重要：通往专业影响力的道路
items.summaryZh: 本文强调了第 57 届 McMillan 讲座主讲人 Christopher M. Powers 博士通过在人体运动科学领域的领导力、下肢生物力学研究以及对专业的持续倡导，对物理治疗领域做出的广泛贡献。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary provides an overview of Professor Christopher M. Powers' career contributions at the 57th McMillan Lecture, without presenting new research findings or clinical practice guidance.

items.title: Prehabilitative Exercise Mitigates Immobilization-Induced Atrophy Through Muscle Reserve Rather Than Resistance to Disuse: The PRE-EX Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: The PRE-EX trial (n=54) demonstrated that prehabilitative exercise mitigated immobilization-induced atrophy by increasing quadriceps CSA by 6.7% and MVC by 15.2% before disuse, rather than by altering the muscle's physiological response to immobilization.
items.curatedReason: PRE-EX 试验坐实了术前康复（prehab）对抗失用性萎缩的关键机制：增加术前肌肉储备，而非改变肌肉对失用的生物学响应。这意味着你应该将术前康复视为建立“缓冲带”，而不是试图阻止失用本身带来的生理变化。积极鼓励患者在制动前进行力量训练。
items.titleZh: 术前康复运动通过肌肉储备而非抵抗失用减轻制动引起的萎缩：PRE-EX 随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: PRE-EX 试验 (n=54) 表明，术前康复运动通过在失用前增加股四头肌截面积 6.7% 和最大自主收缩力 15.2% 来减轻制动引起的萎缩，而非通过改变肌肉对制动的生理反应。
items.curatedReasonEn: The PRE-EX trial confirms the key mechanism of prehabilitation against disuse atrophy: building muscle reserve before disuse, rather than altering the muscle's biological response to disuse. This means you should view prehabilitation as creating a "buffer," not as preventing the physiological changes of disuse itself. Actively encourage patients to engage in strength training before immobilization.
items.limitation: 该研究主要在健康年轻和老年女性中进行，结果在男性或其他病理人群中的普适性仍需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted primarily in healthy younger and older women, and the generalizability of the results to men or other pathological populations still needs further validation.

items.title: Comparative effectiveness of digital health interventions for low back pain: systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials
items.summary: A network meta-analysis of 84 RCTs (n=11,649) found that virtual reality (VR) showed the largest estimated post-intervention effects versus control for low back pain intensity (SMD -1.43, 95% CI -1.87 to -0.98), physical function, pain-related fear avoidance, and health-related quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 这项网络荟萃分析表明，在腰痛的数字健康干预中，VR 在短期疼痛、功能、恐惧回避和生活质量方面效果最大。这提示你可以在合适的场景下，考虑将 VR 作为腰痛患者早期干预的一个有力选项。
items.titleZh: 数字健康干预对腰痛的比较有效性：随机对照试验的系统综述和网络荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 84 项 RCT (n=11,649) 的网络荟萃分析发现，在数字健康干预中，虚拟现实 (VR) 在干预后对腰痛疼痛强度 (SMD -1.43, 95% CI -1.87 至 -0.98)、身体功能、疼痛相关恐惧回避和健康相关生活质量方面显示出最大的估计效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This network meta-analysis suggests that among digital health interventions for low back pain, VR demonstrated the largest short-term effects on pain, function, fear avoidance, and quality of life. This indicates you might consider VR as a strong option for early intervention in suitable low back pain patients.
items.limitation: 随着随访时间延长，证据网络变得稀疏，许多网络估计的置信度较低或非常低，使得长期疗效的确定性不足。
items.limitationEn: The evidence networks became sparse with longer follow-up, and confidence in many network estimates was low or very low, leading to insufficient certainty regarding long-term efficacy.

items.title: Effects of Using High-Frequency TENS During an Exercise Therapy Program in Knee Osteoarthritis: A Randomized Sham-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized, sham-controlled trial with 96 individuals with knee osteoarthritis found that adding high-frequency transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation to an exercise therapy program did not provide additional benefits over sham stimulation for pain or other outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 高频 TENS 对膝关节骨关节炎的运动疗法没有额外益处，这意味着在常规运动处方中加入高频 TENS 辅助镇痛不应成为常规。将资源和注意力集中在运动疗法本身的效果优化上。
items.titleZh: 高频 TENS 辅助运动疗法治疗膝骨关节炎的疗效：一项随机假对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 96 名膝骨关节炎患者的随机、假对照试验显示，在高频 TENS 辅助运动疗法与假刺激相比，未能为疼痛或其他结局带来额外益处，Knee Injury and Osteoarthritis Outcome Score 疼痛子量表调整后均值差异仅 1.05 分（95% CI，-5.19 至 7.29）。
items.curatedReasonEn: High-frequency TENS provided no additional benefit to exercise therapy for knee osteoarthritis, meaning it should not be routinely added to standard exercise prescriptions for pain relief. Focus resources and attention on optimizing the effects of exercise therapy itself.
items.limitation: 本研究未进行正式的盲法评估，随访期短，且缺乏单独的运动组对照，可能限制结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study lacked formal blinding assessment, had a short follow-up, and no exercise-only control group, which may limit the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: A Distal-Proximal Gradient of Hebbian Plasticity in the Human Arm
items.summary: Hebbian stimulation induced greater corticospinal excitability facilitation in the first dorsal interosseous (distal) than in the biceps brachii (proximal) muscle, indicating a distal-to-proximal gradient of Hebbian plasticity in the human arm.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究揭示了人手臂远端肌肉比近端肌肉具有更强的 Hebbian 可塑性。在设计上肢神经调控和康复策略时，需考虑这种远近端差异，以优化治疗效果。
items.titleZh: 人手臂 Hebbian 可塑性的远近端梯度
items.summaryZh: 研究发现，在人手臂中，Hebbian 刺激在远端肌肉（如第一骨间背侧肌）诱导的皮质脊髓兴奋性促进作用强于近端肌肉（如肱二头肌），提示人手臂 Hebbian 可塑性存在远近端梯度。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals a stronger Hebbian plasticity in distal arm muscles compared to proximal ones. When designing upper-limb neuromodulation and rehabilitation strategies, this distal-to-proximal gradient should be considered to optimize therapeutic outcomes.
items.limitation: 该研究是在健康受试者中进行的，其结果在病理状态下的可推广性尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted in healthy subjects, and the generalizability of its findings to pathological conditions is not yet clear.

items.title: Comparative Evaluation of a System One Model and a General-Purpose Large Language Model on the Korean Physical Therapist Licensing Examination
items.summary: GPT-4o achieved 85.8% accuracy on the Korean Physical Therapist Licensing Examination, outperforming Jev (74.2%), while Jev provided valid structured responses for all questions at a lower estimated cost.
items.curatedReason: GPT-4o 在韩国物理治疗师执照考试中的准确率显著高于 System One Model Jev，但 Jev 提供了更可靠的结构化输出和更低的成本。在考虑将 AI 用于物理治疗执业支持时，权衡准确性、成本和输出可靠性至关重要。
items.titleZh: System One 模型与通用大型语言模型在韩国物理治疗师执照考试中的比较评估
items.summaryZh: GPT-4o 在韩国物理治疗师执照考试中的准确率达到 85.8%，优于 Jev (74.2%)；而 Jev 虽准确率较低，但能为所有问题提供有效的结构化回复，且估计成本更低。
items.curatedReasonEn: GPT-4o demonstrated significantly higher accuracy than System One Model Jev on the Korean Physical Therapist Licensing Examination, though Jev provided more reliable structured outputs at a lower cost. When considering AI for physical therapy practice support, balancing accuracy, cost, and output reliability is crucial.
items.limitation: 研究仅限于多项选择题，未能评估模型在开放式临床推理或实际操作中的表现。
items.limitationEn: The study was limited to multiple-choice questions and did not assess the models' performance in open-ended clinical reasoning or practical application.

items.title: Benchmarking large language models on the Ukrainian Krok 2 licensing examination in physical therapy: accuracy, consistency, and agreement
items.summary: Five cloud-based LLMs achieved over 80% accuracy on the Ukrainian Krok 2 Physical Therapy licensing examination, with Gemini 3.5 Flash showing the highest accuracy (93.33%) and ChatGPT-5.5 exhibiting the greatest run-to-run consistency (98.67%).
items.curatedReason: 所有大型语言模型在乌克兰物理治疗师执照考试中的表现均超过合格线，特别是 Gemini 3.5 Flash 展现出最高的准确率。这表明 LLM 有潜力成为物理治疗专业实践中的辅助工具，但你仍需关注其一致性和稳定性。
items.titleZh: 大型语言模型在乌克兰 Krok 2 物理治疗执照考试中的基准测试：准确性、一致性和一致性
items.summaryZh: 五款云端大型语言模型在乌克兰 Krok 2 物理治疗执照考试中均达到 80% 以上的准确率，其中 Gemini 3.5 Flash 准确率最高（93.33%），ChatGPT-5.5 的运行一致性最高（98.67%）。
items.curatedReasonEn: All large language models performed above the passing threshold on the Ukrainian Physical Therapy Licensing Examination, with Gemini 3.5 Flash showing the highest accuracy. This suggests LLMs have potential as auxiliary tools in physical therapy practice, but you should still pay attention to their consistency and stability.
items.limitation: 研究仅评估了多项选择题，未能涵盖 LLM 在临床推理、决策支持或实际操作等方面的能力。
items.limitationEn: The study only evaluated multiple-choice questions, failing to cover LLMs' capabilities in clinical reasoning, decision support, or practical application.

items.title: Knowing when, what, and how to push: Examining the operationalization of task challenge in routine stroke rehabilitation practice using focused video analysis
items.summary: Focused video analysis of eight stroke rehabilitation sessions revealed that task challenge is operationalized through three intersecting practices: structuring challenge-related work, establishing macro-architecture of challenge, and modulating challenge through micro-calibrations.
items.curatedReason: 康复中任务挑战的设计远不止是调整单一参数。记住，你是在通过“构建挑战相关工作”、“确立挑战的宏观架构”以及“微调挑战”这三个方面，与患者动态互动来实施挑战。这是你优化卒中康复的关键。
items.titleZh: 知晓何时、何事、如何施加压力：通过视频分析检验卒中康复中任务挑战的实践操作
items.summaryZh: 对八个卒中康复会话的视频分析显示，任务挑战通过三个交叉实践来操作：构建挑战相关工作、建立挑战的宏观架构以及通过微调来调节挑战，这表明挑战并非简单的任务参数。
items.curatedReasonEn: Designing task challenge in rehab is far more than tweaking a single parameter. Remember, you're operationalizing challenge through dynamic interaction with patients via 'structuring challenge-related work,' 'establishing macro-architecture of challenge,' and 'modulating challenge through micro-calibrations.' This is key to optimizing stroke rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，仅包含八个视频录像的康复会话，可能限制了发现的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study's small sample size, consisting of only eight video-recorded rehabilitation sessions, may limit the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Cardiovascular exercise mitigates inflammation in the early subacute phase of stroke recovery: a secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A secondary analysis of an RCT with 71 stroke patients found that moderate-to-vigorous cardiovascular exercise in the early subacute phase mitigated increases in IL-6, IL-8, and TNF-α compared to standard care.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步证据表明，在中风恢复的早期亚急性期进行心血管运动可能有助于减轻炎症反应。尽管还需要进一步研究确认长期影响，但它为早期康复干预提供了新的视角。
items.titleZh: 心血管运动在中风恢复的早期亚急性期减轻炎症：一项随机对照试验的二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 71 名卒中患者的随机对照试验的二次分析发现，与标准护理相比，在中风恢复的早期亚急性期进行中高强度心血管运动可减轻 IL-6（β=0.585, 95% CI=0.164-1.006, p=0.0073）、IL-8 和 TNF-α 的增加。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preliminary evidence suggests that cardiovascular exercise in the early subacute phase of stroke recovery may help mitigate inflammatory responses. While further research is needed to confirm long-term impacts, it offers a new perspective on early rehabilitation interventions.
items.limitation: 该研究是随机对照试验的二次分析，样本量相对较小，且炎症介质的长期影响尚待确定。
items.limitationEn: This is a secondary analysis of an RCT with a relatively small sample size, and the long-term impact on inflammatory mediators remains to be determined.

items.title: Functional Impairment, Pain, and Fatigue Among Long COVID Survivors in Bangladesh: A Multisite Cross-Sectional Study
items.summary: A multisite cross-sectional study of 240 Long COVID survivors in Bangladesh found common functional limitations, pain, and fatigue, with older age associated with greater impairment and booster vaccination linked to lower pain and fatigue scores.
items.curatedReason: 这项在孟加拉国的研究揭示了长新冠幸存者普遍存在功能障碍、疼痛和疲劳。在评估长新冠患者时，综合考虑其功能状态、疼痛、疲劳及参与度至关重要，并根据国情适配干预策略。
items.titleZh: 孟加拉国长新冠幸存者的功能障碍、疼痛和疲劳：一项多中心横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对孟加拉国 240 名长新冠幸存者的多中心横断面研究发现，功能受限、疼痛和疲劳普遍存在，其中年龄较大与功能障碍更严重相关，加强疫苗接种与疼痛和疲劳评分较低相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study from Bangladesh reveals widespread functional impairment, pain, and fatigue among Long COVID survivors. When assessing Long COVID patients, it is crucial to comprehensively consider their functional status, pain, fatigue, and participation, and adapt intervention strategies to local contexts.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法确定症状与康复干预之间的因果关系，且疫苗接种和烟草使用等亚组样本量较小。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish causality between symptoms and rehabilitation interventions, and subgroups like vaccinated or tobacco non-users had small sample sizes.

items.title: Assessing frailty in lung transplantation candidates
items.summary: In 82 lung transplantation candidates, the Short Physical Performance Battery (SPPB) showed better discrimination than SHARE-FI for frailty in COPD and ILD patients, while SHARE-FI may be suitable for preliminary screening in ILD patients.
items.curatedReason: 对于肺移植候选者，Short Physical Performance Battery (SPPB) 在评估衰弱方面表现优于 SHARE-FI，尤其是在慢性阻塞性肺病 (COPD) 和间质性肺病 (ILD) 患者中。将其纳入评估流程，特别是 SPPB，可以优化对这些患者的风险分层和管理。
items.titleZh: 肺移植候选者的衰弱评估
items.summaryZh: 对 82 名肺移植候选者的研究显示，在 COPD 和 ILD 患者中，Short Physical Performance Battery (SPPB) 在评估衰弱方面表现优于 SHARE-FI，而 SHARE-FI 可能适用于 ILD 患者的初步筛查。
items.curatedReasonEn: For lung transplantation candidates, the Short Physical Performance Battery (SPPB) outperforms SHARE-FI in assessing frailty, especially in patients with COPD and ILD. Integrating SPPB into your assessment workflow can optimize risk stratification and management for these patients.
items.limitation: 该研究样本量有限（82 名患者），且两种衰弱评估工具的一致性较弱，可能影响结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The study's limited sample size (82 patients) and weak concordance between the two frailty assessment tools may affect the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Assessing spoken discourse in aphasia using multimodal artificial intelligence
items.summary: Multimodal AI successfully extracted macrolinguistic and microlinguistic features from movie clip narrations, achieving excellent classification (AUC=0.95) between healthy controls (n=51) and individuals with aphasia (n=54), highlighting its potential for automated discourse assessment.
items.curatedReason: 多模态 AI 在失语症言语分析中的应用前景广阔，能够自动评估宏观和微观语言特征。尽管目前是研究阶段，但这提示未来在失语症临床评估中可能引入更高效、客观的工具。
items.titleZh: 利用多模态人工智能评估失语症言语
items.summaryZh: 多模态 AI 成功从电影剪辑叙事中提取宏观和微观语言特征，在健康对照组 (n=51) 与失语症患者 (n=54) 之间实现了出色的分类 (AUC=0.95)，表明其在失语症自动言语评估中的潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: Multimodal AI shows promising potential in assessing spoken discourse in aphasia by automatically extracting macrolinguistic and microlinguistic features. While still in the research phase, this suggests that more efficient and objective tools may be integrated into clinical aphasia assessment in the future.
items.limitation: 该研究是在健康对照组和失语症患者中进行的，AI 工具在更广泛的临床人群中的有效性仍需验证。
items.limitationEn: The study was conducted in healthy controls and individuals with aphasia, and the effectiveness of the AI tool in a broader clinical population still needs validation.

items.title: Immediate and fatigue-related effects of subtalar sling taping in individuals with chronic ankle instability.
items.summary: An RCT (N=90) on individuals with chronic ankle instability found that Kinesio subtalar sling taping (KST) resulted in higher Y-Balance Test composite scores than sham taping post-fatigue (MD = 4.28, 95% CI 0.16 to 8.40) and after recovery (MD = 4.27, 95% CI 0.15 to 8.39), while rigid subtalar sling taping showed less consistent effects across outcomes and time points.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 发现，在慢性踝关节不稳患者中，亚距骨吊带式肌内效贴布（KST）在疲劳后对 Y 平衡测试表现优于安慰贴布，而硬质贴布效果不一。这提示 KST 可能在改善疲劳状态下的平衡和功能方面有优势，但由于效果在不同结果指标上不一致，您在使用时仍需结合个体情况评估其特定益处，而非盲目作为常规方案。
items.titleZh: 亚距骨吊带式贴扎对慢性踝关节不稳患者的即时及疲劳相关影响。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对慢性踝关节不稳患者的随机对照试验（N=90）发现，亚距骨吊带式肌内效贴布（KST）在疲劳后（MD = 4.28, 95% CI 0.16 to 8.40）和恢复后（MD = 4.27, 95% CI 0.15 to 8.39）的 Y 平衡测试综合得分均高于安慰贴布，而硬质亚距骨吊带式贴布在不同结局和时间点上的效果不尽一致。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that Kinesio subtalar sling taping (KST) improved Y-Balance Test performance more than sham taping after fatigue in individuals with chronic ankle instability, while rigid taping showed inconsistent effects. This suggests KST might offer benefits for balance and function under fatigue. However, due to inconsistent effects across different outcomes, you should assess its specific benefits individually rather than applying it as a routine intervention.
items.limitation: 研究未观察到硬质贴布和肌内效贴布在所有结局指标上的一致优越性，且部分疗效在不同时间点有所不同。
items.limitationEn: The study did not observe consistent superiority of rigid versus Kinesio taping across all outcomes, and some effects varied by time point.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Effects of Somatosensory Interventions on Sensory, Motor, and Balance Functions in Individuals with Stroke: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of nine RCTs (N=330) found that somatosensory interventions significantly improved Berg Balance Scale scores in stroke patients compared to conventional therapy, though no significant effects were observed for upper limb motor function.
items.curatedReason: 躯体感觉干预对卒中患者的平衡功能有显著改善作用。虽然对上肢运动和感觉功能改善的证据尚不充分，但它支持将躯体感觉训练作为卒中康复方案的一部分，尤其是针对平衡障碍的患者。
items.titleZh: 躯体感觉干预对卒中患者感觉、运动和平衡功能的影响：一项系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含9项随机对照试验（N=330）的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，与常规治疗相比，躯体感觉干预显著改善了卒中患者的 Berg 平衡量表评分，但对上肢运动功能无显著影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Somatosensory interventions show a significant improvement in balance function for stroke patients. While evidence for upper limb motor and sensory function improvement is not yet definitive, this supports including somatosensory training in stroke rehabilitation protocols, especially for patients with balance deficits.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学质量存在偏差风险，且缺乏长期随访数据，限制了对干预效果持久性的评估。
items.limitationEn: The included studies had a risk of bias, and a lack of long-term follow-up data limits the assessment of the interventions' sustained effects.

items.title: APTA Presses for Inclusion of CPT Codes in UHC Prior Authorization Reforms
items.summary: APTA is advocating for the inclusion of physical therapy CPT codes in UnitedHealthcare's prior authorization reforms after finding that PT services were excluded from the recently announced 30% reduction in prior authorization requirements.
items.curatedReason: APTA 正在积极推动将物理治疗常用 CPT 代码纳入 UHC 的预授权改革。虽然 UHC 已宣布削减 30% 的预授权要求，但目前 PT 服务仍未受益，这提示你该持续关注政策动态并继续向支付方施压。
items.titleZh: APTA 敦促将 CPT 代码纳入联合健康保险（UHC）的预授权改革
items.summaryZh: APTA 正积极推动将物理治疗的 CPT 代码纳入联合健康保险（UHC）的预授权改革，此前发现 UHC 近期宣布削减 30% 预授权要求的政策并未涵盖物理治疗服务。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA is actively advocating for the inclusion of commonly used physical therapy CPT codes in UHC's prior authorization reforms. While UHC announced a 30% reduction in prior authorization requirements, PT services are not yet benefiting, signaling you to stay updated on policy changes and continue advocating with payers.

items.title: Association Between Admission Serum Albumin and Short-Term Functional Improvement During Inpatient Rehabilitation After Cervical Traumatic Spinal Cord Injury: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A single-center retrospective cohort study of 106 cervical traumatic spinal cord injury patients found that higher serum albumin at rehabilitation admission was associated with greater short-term functional improvement in basic ADL (aOR 1.23 per 1-g/L increase; 95% CI, 1.08-1.41; P=0.002).
items.curatedReason: 本回顾性研究提示，入院血清白蛋白水平较高的颈椎创伤性脊髓损伤患者，短期基本日常生活活动（ADL）功能改善更显著。这个易于获取的指标有助于你进行多变量预后评估。
items.titleZh: 入院血清白蛋白水平与颈椎创伤性脊髓损伤患者短期功能改善的关联：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对106名颈椎创伤性脊髓损伤患者的回顾性队列研究显示，入院时血清白蛋白水平较高与短期基本日常生活活动（ADL）功能改善更显著相关（每增加1g/L，aOR 1.23；95% CI, 1.08-1.41；P=0.002）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study suggests that higher serum albumin levels at admission for cervical traumatic spinal cord injury are associated with greater short-term functional improvement in basic ADL. This easily accessible biomarker can aid in your multivariable prognostic assessment.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心回顾性队列研究，且样本量较小（106例），结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center retrospective cohort study with a relatively small sample size (106 patients), limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Age, resilience, social support, and health literacy as predictors of functional ability in people with spinal cord injury: a 6-month follow-up study.
items.summary: A 6-month follow-up study (N=367) on traumatic spinal cord injury patients found that younger age (β = -0.02; p = 0.028), higher resilience (β = 0.22; p < 0.001), and higher health literacy (β = 0.32; p = 0.001) were significant independent predictors of greater functional ability.
items.curatedReason: 这项为期6个月的随访研究强调，在脊髓损伤患者的早期康复中，年龄、心理韧性、社会支持和健康素养是功能恢复的重要预测因素。这提示你，除了身体训练，也要关注患者的心理和社会资源。
items.titleZh: 年龄、心理韧性、社会支持和健康素养在脊髓损伤患者功能能力中的预测作用：一项6个月随访研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对367名创伤性脊髓损伤住院患者的6个月随访研究发现，较年轻的年龄（β = -0.02; p = 0.028）、较高的心理韧性（β = 0.22; p < 0.001）和较高的健康素养（β = 0.32; p = 0.001）是功能能力更强的独立预测因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This 6-month follow-up study highlights age, resilience, social support, and health literacy as crucial predictors of functional recovery in early rehabilitation for spinal cord injury patients. This suggests focusing on patients' psychological and social resources in addition to physical training.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心随访研究，且功能改善幅度相对温和，结果需要进一步研究验证其临床意义。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center follow-up study, and the observed functional improvement was modest, requiring further research to determine its clinical significance.

items.title: Priorities and design principles for a mobile health (mHealth) application to support self-management of post-stroke aphasia: experience gathering and prioritisation within an experience-based co-design approach.
items.summary: An experience-based co-design study, involving 13 people with aphasia, 8 significant others, and 10 health professionals, identified five design principles for a mobile health (mHealth) application to support self-management of post-stroke aphasia. Principles include connecting users with clinicians and community, linking goals to outcomes, visual progress tracking, and customizability.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究由 13 名失语症患者、8 名家属和 10 名专业人士共同参与，明确了支持中风后失语症自我管理的 mHealth 应用的五个设计原则。未来在开发或推荐这类数字工具时，应优先考虑这些以患者为中心的需求，例如：连接临床医生和社区、将目标与结果挂钩、可视化进度跟踪以及可定制性。
items.titleZh: 中风后失语症自我管理移动健康应用的设计优先事项与原则：基于经验的共同设计研究
items.summaryZh: 一项基于经验的共同设计研究（包括 13 名失语症患者、8 名家属和 10 名健康专业人士）为中风后失语症自我管理移动健康应用确定了五项设计原则，包括连接临床医生与社区、关联目标与结果、可视化追踪进展和可定制性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study, co-designed with 13 people with aphasia, 8 significant others, and 10 health professionals, identified five key design principles for mHealth apps supporting post-stroke aphasia self-management. When developing or recommending such digital tools, prioritize these patient-centered needs, including connecting users with clinicians and community, linking goals to outcomes, visual progress tracking, and customizability.
items.limitation: 本研究基于经验收集与优先排序，侧重于设计原则而非应用效果的量化评估。
items.limitationEn: This study focuses on experience gathering and prioritization for design principles, rather than quantitative evaluation of application efficacy.

items.title: A sex-positive approach to sexual rehabilitation after SCI: exploring women's sexual experiences using participatory action research.
items.summary: A participatory action research study involving 15 Canadian women with spinal cord injury (SCI) explored their sexual experiences using a sex-positive approach. Three main themes emerged: relationship with the self, changes in the body, and intimacy with partners, highlighting the importance of self-confidence, self-exploration, and incorporating assistive devices.
items.curatedReason: 针对 15 名脊髓损伤（SCI）女性的这项研究提示我们，在 SCI 康复中，应以“性积极”的态度探讨患者的性健康需求。这不只是生理功能，更关乎自信心、自我探索以及如何在性亲密中有效运用辅助设备。
items.titleZh: 脊髓损伤后性康复的“性积极”方法：通过参与式行动研究探索女性的性体验
items.summaryZh: 一项参与式行动研究以“性积极”方法探索了 15 名加拿大脊髓损伤（SCI）女性的性体验。研究发现三个主要主题：自我关系、身体变化和与伴侣的亲密关系，强调了自信、自我探索和使用辅助设备的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study of 15 women with spinal cord injury (SCI) suggests that a sex-positive approach is essential when addressing sexual health in SCI rehabilitation. This extends beyond physiological function, encompassing self-confidence, self-exploration, and the effective integration of assistive devices in intimacy.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性性质，样本量较小（15 名加拿大女性），结果的普适性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a relatively small sample size (15 Canadian women), so the generalizability of the findings may be limited.

items.title: Autonomic responses to repeated locomotor perturbations in older adults: dissociation between phasic habituation and sustained tonic arousal.
items.summary: Eighteen older adults underwent repeated gait perturbations, showing that phasic sympathetic nervous system (SNS) responses habituated over six trials, but tonic SNS activity remained elevated, indicating sustained vigilance despite reduced acute responses. A change in perturbation direction renewed the phasic response.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现，老年人在重复性步态扰动中，虽然自主神经系统（SNS）的阶段性（phasic）反应会习惯性减弱，但持续性（tonic）警觉水平仍保持升高。这意味着跌倒预防训练中重复性的扰动暴露有助于习惯性反应，但你仍需要关注患者的持续警觉，并考虑调整训练策略以应对意外情况。
items.titleZh: 老年人重复性步态扰动后的自主神经反应：阶段性习惯与持续性紧张唤醒的分离
items.summaryZh: 18 名老年人在重复性步态扰动中，尽管交感神经系统（SNS）的阶段性反应在六次试验后表现出习惯性减弱，但持续性 SNS 活动仍保持升高，表明尽管急性反应降低但警觉性持续存在。改变扰动方向会重新引发阶段性反应。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found that while phasic sympathetic nervous system (SNS) responses habituate during repeated gait perturbations in older adults, tonic arousal remains elevated. This means repetitive perturbation exposure in fall prevention training helps with habituation, but you still need to monitor sustained vigilance and consider adjusting training strategies for unexpected events.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（18 名老年人），且扰动方向初期均为单向，可能无法完全模拟日常生活中的复杂跌倒场景。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a small sample size (18 older adults) and initially used unilateral perturbation directions, which may not fully replicate complex real-life fall scenarios.
items.journal: Journal of electromyography and kinesiology : official journal of the International Society of Electrophysiological Kinesiology

items.title: Test-Retest Reliability of an Isometric Trunk Flexor and Extensor Test in Community-Dwelling Adults
items.summary: A study with 29 healthy participants found excellent test-retest reliability for isometric trunk flexion (ICC 0.92; 95% CI 0.83-0.96) and extension (ICC 0.93; 95% CI 0.86-0.97) strength using the VALD ForceFrame system, with minimum detectable changes of 71.35N and 101.20N respectively.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究验证了 VALD ForceFrame 系统在社区成人中测量等长躯干屈伸肌力量的重测可靠性，发现其 ICC 分数达到优秀级别（0.92-0.93）。这意味着如果你使用或考虑使用类似标准化系统来评估躯干力量，该设备可以提供可靠的测量结果，从而支持你追踪患者的康复进展。
items.titleZh: 社区成人等长躯干屈伸肌测试的重测可靠性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 29 名健康参与者的研究显示，使用 VALD ForceFrame 系统测量等长躯干屈曲（ICC 0.92；95% CI 0.83-0.96）和伸展（ICC 0.93；95% CI 0.86-0.97）肌力的重测可靠性极佳，最小可检测变化分别为 71.35N 和 101.20N。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study validated the test-retest reliability of the VALD ForceFrame system for isometric trunk flexion and extension strength in community-dwelling adults, reporting excellent ICC scores (0.92-0.93). This means if you use or are considering similar standardized systems for trunk strength assessment, this device can provide reliable measurements, supporting your tracking of patient rehabilitation progress.
items.limitation: 研究对象仅为健康社区成人，结果能否推广到不同病理状况或年龄段的患者尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study subjects were healthy community-dwelling adults, so the generalizability of results to patients with different pathologies or age groups is unclear.

items.title: Percutaneous Electrolysis for the Management of Musculoskeletal Disorders. A Systematic Review With Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis found very low-certainty evidence that adding percutaneous electrolysis (PNE) to therapeutic exercise was not superior to sham or exercise alone for pain or function in tendinopathies. Low-certainty evidence suggested PNE plus exercise might reduce short-to-medium term pain more than dry needling plus exercise in tendinopathy but not in myofascial pain syndrome.
items.curatedReason: 关于肌骨疾患（肌筋膜疼痛综合征和肌腱病）的经皮电解疗法（PNE）的系统综述显示，在加入治疗性运动时，PNE 并不比假治疗或单独运动更优。与干针治疗相比，PNE 在肌腱病方面可能带来短期到中期疼痛缓解，但在肌筋膜疼痛综合征方面无显著差异。不要急于将 PNE 作为常规手段，继续以主动运动为核心。
items.titleZh: 经皮电解疗法治疗肌肉骨骼疾病：系统综述与 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述与 Meta 分析发现，非常低确定性证据表明，在肌腱病中，经皮电解疗法（PNE）联合治疗性运动在短期、中期或长期随访中，对疼痛或功能而言，并不优于假治疗加运动或单独运动。低确定性证据显示，在肌腱病中，PNE 联合治疗性运动与干针治疗相比，短期和中期疼痛减轻更显著，但功能无优势；在肌筋膜疼痛综合征中，PNE 与干针治疗在任何随访期内均无显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review on percutaneous electrolysis (PNE) for musculoskeletal disorders (myofascial pain syndrome and tendinopathy) indicates that when added to therapeutic exercise, PNE is not superior to sham or exercise alone. Compared to dry needling, PNE may offer short-to-medium term pain benefits in tendinopathy but not in myofascial pain syndrome. Avoid prematurely integrating PNE as a standard intervention; maintain active exercise as the core of your treatment.
items.limitation: 证据确定性非常低到低，主要基于小样本随机对照试验，提示需要更多高质量研究。
items.limitationEn: The certainty of evidence ranged from very low to low, primarily based on small RCTs, indicating a need for more high-quality studies.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Short-Term Effects of Radial Extracorporeal Shock Wave Therapy in Addition to Physiotherapy on Spasticity, Walking Performance, and Quality of Life in Chronic Stroke: A Sham-Controlled Randomized Trial.
items.summary: A sham-controlled randomized trial (n=85) found that adding 4 weeks of radial extracorporeal shock wave therapy (rESWT) to physiotherapy significantly improved spasticity (MAS mean difference -0.56, 95% CI -0.77 to -0.35), walking performance (10MWT -1.41 s), motor function (FMA-LE 4.42), and quality of life (SS-QOL 11.73) in chronic stroke patients with plantar flexor spasticity.
items.curatedReason: 这项高质量 RCT 证实了在物理治疗基础上，径向体外冲击波疗法（rESWT）在慢性卒中患者中能显著改善痉挛、步态表现和生活质量。将其视为一种有效的辅助治疗手段，可以纳入你的卒中康复方案，尤其关注其对痉挛、步态和功能提升的短期效果。
items.titleZh: 径向体外冲击波疗法联合物理治疗对慢性卒中痉挛、步行表现和生活质量的短期效果：一项假对照随机试验
items.summaryZh: 一项假对照随机试验（n=85）发现，在标准化物理治疗基础上增加 4 周径向体外冲击波疗法（rESWT），能显著改善慢性卒中患者的痉挛程度（MAS 调整后均值差异 -0.56, 95% CI -0.77 至 -0.35）、步行表现（10MWT -1.41 秒）、运动功能（FMA-LE 4.42）和生活质量（SS-QOL 11.73）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality RCT confirms that radial extracorporeal shock wave therapy (rESWT), when added to physiotherapy, significantly improves spasticity, walking performance, and quality of life in chronic stroke patients. Consider it an effective adjunctive treatment to integrate into your stroke rehabilitation protocols, especially focusing on its short-term effects on spasticity, gait, and functional improvement.
items.limitation: 研究仅评估了短期效果，长期疗效和安全性仍需进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: The study only evaluated short-term effects; long-term efficacy and safety require further investigation.

items.title: Cerebellar Theta-Burst Stimulation Induces Distinct Functional Connectivity Patterns in Post-Stroke Aphasia: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that cerebellar continuous theta burst stimulation (cTBS) did not confer significant overall language recovery benefit in subacute post-stroke aphasia (PSA) patients, but selectively improved repetition performance (P = .034). Functional connectivity changes between right cerebellar Crus I and temporo-occipital regions were associated with behavioral outcomes, showing marked inter-individual variability.
items.curatedReason: 对于亚急性卒中后失语症患者，小脑 Theta-Burst 刺激虽然没有带来总体语言功能的显著改善，但特异性地提升了重复语言表现。将这作为未来更精确靶向干预和个性化治疗的线索，尤其是在关注特定语言领域时。
items.titleZh: 小脑 Theta-Burst 刺激在卒中后失语症中诱导独特的连接模式：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，右侧小脑 Crus I 的抑制性连续 theta-burst 刺激（cTBS）在亚急性卒中后失语症（PSA）患者中未带来总体语言恢复的显著益处，但选择性改善了重复语言表现（P = .034）。功能连接性成像显示，右侧小脑 Crus I 与右侧颞枕区域的连接性变化与行为结果相关，并存在显著的个体间差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with subacute post-stroke aphasia, cerebellar theta-burst stimulation did not significantly improve overall language function, but it did selectively enhance repetition performance. Use this as a clue for future, more precisely targeted interventions and personalized treatments, especially when focusing on specific language domains.
items.limitation: 研究样本量有限，结果存在个体差异，需要更大规模研究验证。
items.limitationEn: The study had a limited sample size and showed inter-individual variability, requiring validation in larger studies.

items.title: Availability in elite football: a practical framework for recording and communicating player health status
items.summary: This article proposes a practical framework for recording and communicating player health status in elite football, moving beyond traditional 'time-loss' surveillance. It aims to provide coaching and performance staff with consistent information on player availability (fully fit, managing a niggle, restricted, or out) to better plan training and matches.
items.curatedReason: 这份框架为精英足球运动员的健康状况记录和沟通提供了实用方法，超越了传统的“时间损失”指标。你可以将这种更精细的“可用性”评估引入你的运动员康复和训练管理中，更好地与教练团队沟通球员状态，优化训练负荷和伤病管理。
items.titleZh: 精英足球运动员的“可用性”：记录和沟通球员健康状态的实用框架
items.summaryZh: 本文提出了一个记录和沟通精英足球运动员健康状态的实用框架，旨在超越传统的“时间损失”监测方法。其目标是为教练和表现管理团队提供关于球员“可用性”（完全健康、轻伤管理、受限或缺阵）的一致信息，以更好地规划训练和比赛。
items.curatedReasonEn: This framework offers a practical approach for recording and communicating elite football players' health status, moving beyond traditional 'time-loss' metrics. You can integrate this more refined 'availability' assessment into your athlete rehabilitation and training management to better communicate player status with coaching staff, optimizing training load and injury management.

items.title: Peripheral arterial disease: adverse impacts, disparities in outcomes, and the path ahead.
items.summary: The third paper in The Lancet's PAD Series describes the devastating effects of peripheral arterial disease (PAD), including chronic pain, functional limitation, and high risk of major adverse events. It highlights disparities in outcomes for underserved groups and recommends short-term changes like multidisciplinary care models and long-term changes like early screening and management.
items.curatedReason: 这份 PAD 系列论文强调了外周动脉疾病（PAD）给患者带来的巨大负面影响和健康不平等。了解 PAD 的多学科管理模式、运动疗法和早期干预的必要性，这能优化你对 PAD 患者的转诊和康复计划，特别是在服务不足人群中。
items.titleZh: 外周动脉疾病：不良影响、结果差异及未来之路
items.summaryZh: 《柳叶刀》PAD 系列的第三篇论文描述了外周动脉疾病（PAD）的毁灭性影响，包括慢性疼痛、功能受限和高危严重不良事件。文章强调了服务不足人群中存在的结局差异，并提出了短期改进（如多学科护理模式）和长期变革（如早期筛查和管理）的建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PAD series paper highlights the significant adverse impacts and health disparities associated with peripheral arterial disease (PAD). Understanding the necessity of multidisciplinary management models, exercise therapy, and early intervention for PAD will optimize your referral and rehabilitation plans for PAD patients, especially in underserved populations.

items.title: Get trained, save lives: turning a mega sport event into a CPR training platform
items.summary: This commentary highlights that mega sport events, despite generating massive attention for issues like CPR after the Christian Eriksen incident, often fail to translate this into sustained public health action or integrated training pathways. It argues that health initiatives linked to these events typically focus on short-term awareness rather than real knowledge acquisition.
