items.curatedReason: 这篇文章讨论了利用大型体育赛事提升 CPR 培训的契机，但指出此类健康倡议往往是短期、注重意识而非系统整合。这提醒你在社区健康教育中，应着眼于长期、可持续的知识和技能转化，避免只追求短期关注度。
items.titleZh: 接受培训，挽救生命：将大型体育赛事转化为 CPR 培训平台
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论指出，大型体育赛事尽管能引发对心肺复苏（CPR）等话题的巨大关注，但通常未能将这种关注转化为持续的公共卫生行动或整合的培训途径。文章认为，与这些赛事相关的健康倡议通常侧重于短期意识提升，而非实际知识获取。
items.curatedReasonEn: This article discusses the missed opportunity to leverage mega sports events for CPR training, noting that such health initiatives are often short-term and awareness-focused rather than systematically integrated. This reminds you that in community health education, you should focus on long-term, sustainable knowledge and skill transfer, avoiding the pursuit of short-term attention.

items.title: Altitude challenges at the FIFA World Cup 2026: lessons to prepare and minimise the risks in future tournaments
items.summary: This commentary discusses the altitude challenges presented by the FIFA World Cup 2026 in Mexico City (2240 m), highlighting how reduced oxygen and lower air resistance impair physical and decision-making performance in football. It emphasizes the need to consider altitude's impact given the expanded tournament format.
items.curatedReason: 2026 年世界杯的高海拔挑战再次凸显了海拔对运动员表现和决策的影响。在评估和训练运动员时，尤其是在高海拔环境中，你需要考虑其对体能和技战术表现的具体影响，并据此调整康复和训练计划。
items.titleZh: 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯的海拔挑战：未来赛事准备和风险最小化的经验教训
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论讨论了 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯在墨西哥城（海拔 2240 米）面临的海拔挑战，强调了氧气减少和空气阻力降低如何损害足球运动员的体能和决策表现。文章指出，鉴于赛事规模的扩大，考虑海拔影响的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The altitude challenges at the 2026 FIFA World Cup once again highlight the impact of altitude on athlete performance and decision-making. When evaluating and training athletes, especially in high-altitude environments, you need to consider its specific effects on physical fitness and technical/tactical performance, and adjust rehabilitation and training plans accordingly.

items.title: Effect of Music-Based Interventions in Cardiac Rehabilitation: A Systematic Review.
items.summary: A systematic review of nine studies found music-based interventions in cardiac rehabilitation primarily improved psychological outcomes, motivation, exercise adherence, and functional performance, serving as supportive adjuncts rather than directly affecting cardiovascular parameters.
items.curatedReason: 该系统综述提示音乐干预作为心脏康复的辅助手段，可能通过改善患者心理健康、动机和依从性来提高疗效，而非直接影响心血管参数。你可以在临床实践中考虑引入音乐元素，以提升患者参与度和心理舒适度，但不要期望其能替代核心的心脏康复运动或直接带来生理上的心血管改善。
items.titleZh: 音乐干预在心脏康复中的效果：一项系统综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项对九项研究的系统综述发现，心脏康复中的音乐干预主要改善了心理结果、动机、运动依从性和功能表现，作为辅助手段而非直接影响心血管参数。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review suggests music-based interventions as an adjunct in cardiac rehabilitation may enhance outcomes by improving psychological well-being, motivation, and adherence, rather than directly affecting cardiovascular parameters. You can consider incorporating music into clinical practice to boost patient engagement and psychological comfort, but do not expect it to replace core cardiac rehab exercises or directly lead to physiological cardiovascular improvements.
items.limitation: 纳入研究主要关注心理和依从性结局，对直接心血管参数的评估有限，且缺乏高质量、大样本的长期研究。
items.limitationEn: Included studies primarily focused on psychological and adherence outcomes, with limited assessment of direct cardiovascular parameters, and a lack of high-quality, large-cohort, long-term studies.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Trunk and Pelvic Control in the Acute Phase After Stroke: A Clinical Movement Analysis Case Study Using the Ottawa Sitting Scale.
items.summary: A single-case study found the Ottawa Sitting Scale (OSS) feasible for bedside assessment of trunk and pelvic control in a 77-year-old acute ischemic stroke patient, capturing early improvements in static sitting and reaching, while highlighting persistent limitations in scooting over six days.
items.curatedReason: 本案例研究表明，渥太华坐姿量表（OSS）可用于急性卒中患者床边躯干和骨盆控制的早期评估，识别静态坐姿和伸手任务的改善。这提示了临床中结合 OSS 早期进行详细运动分析的潜力，特别是对于躯干旋转和滑行等持续性功能障碍。
items.titleZh: 卒中急性期躯干和骨盆控制：一项采用渥太华坐姿量表的临床运动分析病例研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项单案例研究显示，渥太华坐姿量表（OSS）可用于一名 77 岁急性缺血性卒中患者的床边躯干和骨盆控制评估，并在六天内捕捉到静态坐姿和伸手任务的早期改善，同时揭示了滑行等动作的持续局限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case study demonstrates the Ottawa Sitting Scale (OSS) can be used for early bedside assessment of trunk and pelvic control in acute stroke patients, identifying improvements in static sitting and reaching tasks. This suggests its potential for early detailed movement analysis in clinical practice, especially for persistent dysfunctions like trunk rotation and scooting.
items.limitation: 这是一项单案例研究，无法推广其发现。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-case study, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence in Extended Reality and Digital Rehabilitation Technologies for Fall Prevention in Older Adults: A Rapid Review of the Evidence.
items.summary: A rapid review of four studies found extended reality (XR) and virtual reality (VR) interventions improved mobility, movement quality, and muscular strength in older adults, with high engagement. However, evidence for direct fall reduction and the added benefits of AI was limited, as AI was primarily used for movement classification and postural control analysis.
items.curatedReason: 此快速综述证实了 XR/VR 干预在改善老年人平衡和活动能力方面的有效性，但同时指出 AI 的额外益处和直接跌倒发生率的证据仍然有限。在临床实践中，你可以放心地将 XR/VR 作为辅助手段提高患者参与度和依从性，但不要将其宣传为直接减少跌倒的解决方案，也不要高估现有 AI 功能的临床价值。
items.titleZh: 人工智能在扩展现实和数字康复技术中预防老年人跌倒的应用：一项证据快速综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项对四项研究的快速综述发现，扩展现实（XR）和虚拟现实（VR）干预能改善老年人的活动能力、运动质量和肌肉力量，且参与度高。然而，直接减少跌倒和 AI 附加益处的证据有限，AI 主要用于运动分类和姿势控制分析。
items.curatedReasonEn: This rapid review confirms the effectiveness of XR/VR interventions in improving balance and mobility in older adults, but notes that evidence for the added benefits of AI and direct fall incidence reduction remains limited. In clinical practice, you can confidently use XR/VR as an adjunct to enhance patient engagement and adherence, but avoid promoting it as a direct fall reduction solution or overestimating the clinical value of current AI features.
items.limitation: 这项快速综述纳入的 AI 相关的 XR/VR 跌倒预防研究数量有限（仅四项），且无研究直接测量跌倒发生率。
items.limitationEn: This rapid review included a limited number of AI-related XR/VR studies for fall prevention (only four), and none directly measured fall incidence.

items.title: Predictors of response to spinal manipulative therapy, dry needling and exercise in patients with cervicogenic headache.
items.summary: A secondary analysis of 142 cervicogenic headache patients receiving spinal manipulative therapy, dry needling, and exercise found male sex (OR: 3.906, 95% CI: 1.263, 12.195) and baseline headache intensity (OR: 1.708, 95% CI: 1.203, 2.424) were the strongest predictors of achieving a ≥50% improvement in headache intensity at 3 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究发现男性和基线头痛强度更高是颈源性头痛患者接受手法治疗、干针和运动后获得成功结局的独立预测因子。你可以将这些因素纳入患者评估，帮助识别可能从这些综合干预中获益更大的患者，从而优化治疗方案和患者预期管理。
items.titleZh: 颈源性头痛患者对脊柱手法治疗、干针和运动反应的预测因子。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 142 名接受脊柱手法治疗、干针和运动的颈源性头痛患者的二次分析发现，男性（OR: 3.906, 95% CI: 1.263, 12.195）和较高的基线头痛强度（OR: 1.708, 95% CI: 1.203, 2.424）是患者在 3 个月时头痛强度改善 ≥50% 的最强预测因子。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study found male sex and higher baseline headache intensity to be independent predictors of successful outcomes for cervicogenic headache patients receiving spinal manipulative therapy, dry needling, and exercise. You can incorporate these factors into patient assessment to help identify individuals more likely to benefit from these combined interventions, thereby optimizing treatment plans and patient expectation management.
items.limitation: 这是一项对已完成 RCT 的二次分析，预测因子仅限于原始研究中收集的变量，且未评估个体干预的单独效应。
items.limitationEn: This is a secondary analysis of a completed RCT, with predictors limited to variables collected in the original study, and it did not assess the individual effects of each intervention.

items.title: Specialised Acquired Brain Injury Community Outreach Provision - a Service Evaluation Cohort to Enable Practice Development and Improvement.
items.summary: A service evaluation of a UK specialized community outreach program for acquired brain injury (ABI) showed activity doubled from 2019-2025, with primary referrals for spasticity (n=2821) and complex physical management (n=2393), indicating expanding utilization for severe disability in the community.
items.curatedReason: 这项服务评估展示了英国社区外展服务对获得性脑损伤患者，特别是痉挛管理，需求日益增长的趋势。结果提示你，在处理复杂神经系统疾病（如卒中和脑损伤）的社区管理时，与专业服务建立伙伴关系是提高患者照护和减少服务不平等的关键。
items.titleZh: 专业获得性脑损伤社区外展服务：一项旨在促进实践发展和改进的服务评估队列研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对英国获得性脑损伤（ABI）专业社区外展服务的评估显示，2019-2025 年间服务量翻倍，主要转诊原因为痉挛管理（n=2821）和复杂躯体管理（n=2393），表明社区对严重残疾患者服务的利用率不断扩大。
items.curatedReasonEn: This service evaluation highlights the growing demand for community outreach services for acquired brain injury patients in the UK, particularly for spasticity management. The results suggest that forming partnerships with specialized services is key to improving patient care and reducing service inequity when managing complex neurological conditions like stroke and brain injury in the community.
items.limitation: 这是一项服务评估，数据来自单一区域服务，且为回顾性分析，可能存在选择偏倚和数据完整性限制。
items.limitationEn: This is a service evaluation based on data from a single regional service and retrospectively analyzed, which may have selection bias and data completeness limitations.

items.title: Structured exercise interventions and survival outcomes in patients with cancer: systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 21 RCTs (n=3828 for OS) found structured exercise associated with significant improvements in overall survival (HR 0.77, 95% CI 0.65-0.92), disease-free survival (HR 0.83, 95% CI 0.72-0.95), all-cause mortality (RR 0.82, 95% CI 0.70-0.97), and cancer-specific mortality (RR 0.74, 95% CI 0.57-0.96). Evidence certainty was moderate for key outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项高质量系统综述和荟萃分析有力地证实了结构化运动干预在癌症患者生存结局中的关键作用，能够显著降低总生存期、无病生存期、全因死亡率和癌症特异性死亡率。这坐实了运动疗法作为肿瘤治疗辅助手段的地位，在与肿瘤科医生讨论转诊时，这是您手里最硬的证据。
items.titleZh: 癌症患者的结构化运动干预与生存结局：随机对照试验的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对 21 项随机对照试验（RCTs，OS 队列 n=3828）的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，结构化运动与总生存期（HR 0.77, 95% CI 0.65-0.92）、无病生存期（HR 0.83, 95% CI 0.72-0.95）、全因死亡率（RR 0.82, 95% CI 0.70-0.97）和癌症特异性死亡率（RR 0.74, 95% CI 0.57-0.96）的显著改善相关。关键结局的证据确定性为中等。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality systematic review and meta-analysis solidifies the survival benefits of structured exercise for cancer patients: overall survival, disease-free survival, all-cause mortality, and cancer-specific mortality are all significantly reduced. This is the strongest evidence you can present when discussing referrals with oncologists.
items.limitation: 证据等级评估为中等，且亚组分析显示效果在依从性较高、有氧运动以及早期癌症患者中更为显著，可能存在异质性。
items.limitationEn: The certainty of evidence was rated as moderate, and exploratory analyses suggested more pronounced benefits among participants with higher adherence, those who underwent aerobic exercise, and those with early-stage disease, indicating potential heterogeneity.

items.title: Do blood flow restriction exercises offer additional benefits when compared to conventional exercises in musculoskeletal rehabilitation? A systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 45 RCTs (n=1652) found low-certainty evidence that low-load exercise with blood flow restriction (LLE-BFR) was superior to low-load exercise (LLE) for muscle strength (SMD=0.82) and disability (SMD=0.63). Moderate-certainty evidence showed no clear difference between LLE-BFR and high-load exercise (HLE) for muscle strength (SMD=0.08). Pain reductions for LLE-BFR were small and not clinically meaningful.
items.curatedReason: 这项高质量系统综述明确指出，低负荷血流限制训练（LLE-BFR）在肌肉骨骼康复中优于单纯的低负荷训练（LLE），能显著提升肌力和改善功能。当你需要为肌力不足或负荷限制的患者提供训练时，LLE-BFR 应成为你的首选方案。但其与高负荷训练（HLE）的效果相似，且对疼痛的改善并不显著。
items.titleZh: 在肌肉骨骼康复中，血流限制训练与传统训练相比是否提供额外益处？一项系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 这项对 45 项 RCT（n=1652）的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，低确定性证据表明，低负荷血流限制训练（LLE-BFR）在肌力（SMD=0.82）和残疾（SMD=0.63）方面优于低负荷训练（LLE）。中等确定性证据显示，LLE-BFR 与高负荷训练（HLE）在肌力方面无明显差异（SMD=0.08）。LLE-BFR 带来的疼痛减轻幅度较小，不具临床意义。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality systematic review clearly indicates that low-load exercise with blood flow restriction (LLE-BFR) is superior to low-load exercise (LLE) alone for improving muscle strength and disability in musculoskeletal rehabilitation. LLE-BFR should be your preferred option when training patients with insufficient strength or load limitations. However, its effects are similar to high-load exercise (HLE), and its impact on pain reduction is not clinically meaningful.
items.limitation: 许多纳入试验存在“一些担忧”的偏倚风险，且关于不良事件的监测和报告不一致。
items.limitationEn: Many included trials had 'some concerns' regarding risk of bias, and adverse event monitoring and reporting were inconsistent across trials.

items.title: Removing barriers to physical activity for people with long-term conditions: co-creating patient-centred guidance through a multistakeholder consensus approach
items.summary: Multistakeholder consensus developed patient-centered digital guidance to remove barriers to physical activity for people with long-term conditions, providing an alternative to routine medical clearance. Four headline safety statements and seven symptom-specific statements address musculoskeletal pain, fatigue, and other conditions.
items.curatedReason: 慢性病患者参与运动的医疗许可障碍有望缓解。这份多方共识指南提供了 4 条核心安全声明和 7 条针对症状的具体建议，让你能更灵活地评估患者，减少不必要的转诊负担。
items.titleZh: 消除慢性病患者参与体育活动的障碍：通过多方利益相关者共识方法共同创建以患者为中心的指南
items.summaryZh: 多方利益相关者共同制定了以患者为中心的数字指南，旨在消除慢性病患者参与体育活动的障碍，为常规医疗许可提供替代方案。四项主要安全声明和七项针对特定症状的声明涵盖了肌肉骨骼疼痛、疲劳和其他疾病。
items.curatedReasonEn: Barriers to physical activity for people with long-term conditions may be reduced. This multistakeholder consensus offers 4 headline safety statements and 7 symptom-specific recommendations, allowing you more flexibility in assessing patients and reducing unnecessary referral burdens.

items.title: From evidence to action: a global call to advance sleep health in sport
items.summary: This editorial calls for advancing sleep health in sport, presenting evidence-based practices to address misalignments between high-performance environments and healthy sleep/circadian biology. It emphasizes that sleep health is a multidimensional construct crucial for athlete performance.
items.curatedReason: 这份社论强调了运动中睡眠健康的重要性，并提出了基于证据的实践。它提醒您，在运动员康复和表现训练中，应将睡眠健康视为多维度的关键要素，并优化训练环境以支持其生理需求。
items.titleZh: 从证据到行动：全球呼吁提升运动中的睡眠健康
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论呼吁在运动中提升睡眠健康，提出了基于证据的实践，以解决高性能环境与健康睡眠/昼夜节律生物学之间的不一致。它强调睡眠健康是一个对运动员表现至关重要的多维度结构。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial highlights the importance of sleep health in sports and proposes evidence-based practices. It reminds you to consider sleep health as a crucial, multidimensional factor in athlete rehabilitation and performance training, and to optimize training environments to support physiological needs.

items.title: Training-related concussions in mens English Premiership Rugby Union: an eight-season prospective cohort study of 153 243 player-weeks
items.summary: A prospective cohort study (8 seasons, 153,243 player-weeks) found training-related concussion incidence in elite men's English Premiership Rugby Union was 0.23 per 1000 hours, with a mean severity of 18 days absence. Preseason (IRR 1.80, 95% CI 1.24-2.60) and full-contact training (IRR 2.20, 95% CI 1.17-4.12) were associated with higher risk.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性队列研究揭示了英格兰橄榄球联盟训练相关脑震荡的风险因素，特别是季前赛和全面接触训练。您在为橄榄球运动员规划训练时，应战略性地调整这些高风险时期的训练强度与类型，以降低脑震荡风险。
items.titleZh: 英格兰男子橄榄球超级联赛中与训练相关的脑震荡：一项为期八个赛季的 153,243 运动员周前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性队列研究（8 个赛季，153,243 运动员周）发现，英格兰男子橄榄球超级联赛精英运动员训练相关脑震荡发生率为每 1000 小时 0.23 例，平均严重程度为缺勤 18 天。季前赛（IRR 1.80, 95% CI 1.24-2.60）和全面接触训练（IRR 2.20, 95% CI 1.17-4.12）与较高的风险相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study reveals risk factors for training-related concussions in English Premiership Rugby Union, particularly during preseason and full-contact training. When planning training for rugby players, you should strategically adjust the intensity and type of training during these high-risk periods to minimize concussion risk.
items.limitation: 这项研究是观察性的，不能确立因果关系，并且仅限于英格兰橄榄球联盟的精英男性运动员。
items.limitationEn: This study is observational, cannot establish causality, and is limited to elite men's Rugby Union in England.

items.title: Combinations of stepping intensity and daily step counts against all-cause and cardiovascular disease mortality: insights from a device-based prospective study
items.summary: A prospective cohort study (n=64,743) found that combinations of stepping intensity (peak 30-min cadence) and daily step counts are associated with all-cause and cardiovascular disease mortality, with 7500–10,000 steps/day and ~100 steps/min showing the lowest risk for all-cause mortality.
items.curatedReason: 这项大型观察性研究提示，要最大化全因和心血管疾病死亡率的健康收益，患者可能需要在达到 7500–10,000 步/天的同时，将步频维持在 ~100 步/分钟。在推荐日常活动时，我们不应只关注步数，中高强度步频同样重要。
items.titleZh: 步频与每日步数联合对全因和心血管疾病死亡率的影响：一项基于穿戴设备的前瞻性研究的见解
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性队列研究（n=64,743）发现，步频与每日步数的不同组合与全因及心血管疾病死亡率相关，其中每日 7500–10,000 步且峰值 30 分钟步频约 100 步/分钟的全因死亡率风险最低。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large observational study suggests that to maximize health benefits for all-cause and cardiovascular disease mortality, patients likely need to combine 7500–10,000 steps/day with a cadence of ~100 steps/min. When recommending daily physical activity, do not focus solely on step counts; moderate-to-high stepping intensity is equally crucial.
items.limitation: 这是一项前瞻性队列研究，尽管样本量大，但作为观察性研究，无法建立因果关系，且结果可能受到未测量混杂因素的影响。
items.limitationEn: This is a prospective cohort study; despite its large sample size, as an observational study, it cannot establish causality and results may be influenced by unmeasured confounding factors.

items.title: Multidimensional evidence map of sport science and medicine research in highly trained, elite and world-class female athletes: a scoping review
items.summary: A comprehensive scoping review of 3,867 records (1970–2025) on sport science and medicine research in highly trained female athletes found persistent gaps in participant representation, geographical coverage, and health-related themes like pelvic floor and breast health.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围审查清晰地绘制了针对高水平女性运动员的运动科学与医学研究图谱，揭示了研究空白。如果你在治疗女性运动员，这个图谱能帮你找到现有证据，并提醒你盆底健康、乳房健康和围绝经期研究的不足。
items.titleZh: 高水平、精英及世界级女性运动员运动科学与医学研究的多维度证据图谱：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖 3,867 份记录（1970–2025 年）的范围综述绘制了高水平女性运动员运动科学与医学研究图谱，发现参与者代表性、地理覆盖以及盆底健康、乳房健康等主题仍存在研究空白。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review clearly maps the landscape of sport science and medicine research for highly trained female athletes, highlighting existing gaps. If you treat female athletes, this map helps you locate current evidence and alerts you to the deficiencies in research on pelvic floor health, breast health, and perimenopause.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，通过对既有文献的归纳总结，不涉及原始数据分析或效应量计算，其价值在于识别研究趋势和空白。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review that synthesizes existing literature without original data analysis or effect size calculations; its value lies in identifying research trends and gaps.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Health practitioners on notice over unmanaged conflicts of interest
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) and National Boards have issued new interim guidance on managing financial or commercial conflicts of interest for registered health practitioners, reminding them to prioritize patient best interests and comply with professional obligations.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚 AHPRA 发布了关于医疗从业者管理利益冲突的新指南，强调了财务或商业利益可能对临床决策产生的潜在影响。如果你在澳大利亚执业，务必审视自己的业务模式和转诊关系，确保所有行为都符合职业道德规范，以患者最佳利益为先。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构：健康从业者须警惕未管理的利益冲突
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构（Ahpra）和国家委员会发布了关于管理注册健康从业者财务或商业利益冲突的最新临时指南，提醒从业者必须将患者的最佳利益置于首位，并遵守职业义务。
items.curatedReasonEn: AHPRA in Australia has issued new guidance on managing conflicts of interest for healthcare practitioners, emphasizing the potential impact of financial or commercial interests on clinical decision-making. If you practice in Australia, you must review your business models and referral relationships to ensure all actions comply with professional ethics and prioritize the patient's best interests.
